node.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

He is a founding member and the leader of Tokyo Manji Gang.
 
Mikey is usually a carefree teenager who loves to joke and play pranks around those he considers his close friends. He cares for them greatly and is determined to protect their honor. He rarely shows any sign of weakness, as he believes himself to be the foundation and support for Toman, and if the pillar himself were to display weakness, Toman would also be weakened.

~!Younger brother of [Shinichiro](https://anilist.co/character/221297/Shinichirou-Sano), older half brother of [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/171924/Emma-Sano) and younger "adoptive" brother of [Izana](https://anilist.co/character/170484/Izana-Kurokawa)!~

__Height:__ 168 cm

Chifuyu is the vice-captain of the First Division of Tokyo Manji gang and [Baji](https://anilist.co/character/145343)'s best friend.

~!He is the first one to get to know about [Takemichi](https://anilist.co/character/145342)'s time leap ability. After that, he regularly helps Takemichi to think about saving the future.!~

~!Takemichi sought his help in order to team up and face Kanto Manji, the newest [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341)'s gang. He also demands that their team should be called Thousand Winters. Chifuyu also made the uniforms.!~

alternative: Vice-Leader of The Tokyo 卍 Gang

node.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Draken is [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341/Manjirou-Sano)'s best friend and one of the founders of Toman. 

Draken is a muscular teenager who is exceptionally tall for his age. His head is shaven on the sides and back to expose his signature dragon tattoo on his left temple. His blonde hair is long on the top of his head and kept in a neat braid. Draken is a serious teen who lives in a brothel, he does not know his biological parents and was 'taken in' by the owners of the brothel.

~!His mother was a prostitute who abandoned him at birth and died when he was two years old.!~

~!In the future, Draken owns a bike shop, and is a member of Brahman.!~

__Height:__ 175 cm

Captain of the 1st division and one of the founders of the Tokyo Manji Gang.

Baji has a wild personality. He loves the thrill of adrenaline and [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341) himself says that he would punch someone out on the street for no apparent reason, only because he feels like it. In combat, he is never without his trademark grin.

__Height:__ 170 cm

Mitsuya is the Captain of the Second Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. He is a calm, levelheaded person who is also the source of positivity in the gang. Despite his rough upbringing, he tackles every day with a smile. Mitsuya is a pacifist, preferring to not get into an altercation if possible, but at the same time, will not hesitate to fight in order to protect what is dear to him.

Older brother of [Luna Mitsuya](https://anilist.co/character/272864/Mitsuya-Luna) & Mana Mitsuya. He is a childhood friend of [Draken](https://anilist.co/character/145345/Ken-Ryuuguji).

__Height:__ 165 cm

Takemichi learns that the girl he dated in middle school—the only girl he ever dated—has died. Then, after an accident he finds himself in a time leap back to his middle school years. He vows to change the future and save the girl, and to do that he aims to rise to the top of the Kantou region's most brutal delinquent gang.

~!After the fight with Valhalla he becomes the First division Capitan of Toman.!~

~!He later became the eleventh President of the Black Dragons as well as the captain of the First Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang, and a member of Brahman.!~

~!Takemichi is also the president and founder (with [Chifuyu Matsuno](https://anilist.co/character/145344/Matsuno-Chifuyu)) of the Thousand Winters (later renamed as Tokyo Manji), created to defeat Kanto Manji.!~

__Height:__ 174 cm One of the founders of the Tokyo Manji Gang and former number 3 of Valhalla. Kazutora is a very broken soul; as a child, he was forced to pick between his mom and dad in a case of domestic violence. As a result of his fundamentally non-existent family life, he scorned upon other happy families. Something as simple as seeing children having tender moments with their parents, triggered a sore spot within Kazutora and irritated him deeply. ~!He sat 2 years in juvie for the murder of Shinichirou Sano, and he is expected to face at least 10 years in juvie, for stabbing Keisuke Baji. Even though they were the most important people in Mikey's life, he still forgave Kazutora, and told him that he is a part of Toman.!~

__Height:__ 153 cm

Hinata Tachibana is the girlfriend of [Takemichi Hanagaki](https://anilist.co/character/145342/Hanagaki-Takemichi) who is the primary reason for Takemichi's desire to change the past. In 2005, Hinata is a 14 year old girl. 

Hinata has light brown eyes and wears her rosy brown hair a little longer than before: it goes beyond her shoulders. She is seen wearing a long black dress with embroidered flowers. She also wears a necklace around her neck, materializing her relationship with Takemichi Hanagaki during their middle school years.

Hinata has a very outgoing and upbeat personality who is highly optimistic and always finds ways to make undesirable situations better. Even when others become demoralized or despair, Hinata remains strong in order to push them forward.

~!On July 4, 2017, Hinata will be killed during a brawl between two Tokyo gangs, along with her brother [Naoto Tachibana](https://anilist.co/character/167843/Tachibana-Naoto).!~

__Height:__ 165 cm

Due to his years alone, Izana became ruthless and cruel. Not only has he become mentally unstable but, he strives for absolute power. Izana is the former leader of the eighth generation Black Dragons as well as the former president of Tenjiku. He is one of the main antagonists of The Tenjiku Arc.

__Height:__ 170cm

Vice captain of the Fourth Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. He's the younger twin brother of [Nahoya Kawata](https://anilist.co/character/168679/Nahoya-Kawata).

__Height:__ 170 cm

Captain of the Fourth Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. Brother to [Souya Kawata](https://anilist.co/character/168678/Souya-Kawata).

__Height:__ 177 cm

Former tenth generation Black Dragons commander and the current vice captain of the Black Dragons.

Inupi is usually a stoic and quiet individual. However, he isn't afraid to voice his thoughts and opinions even if it hurts him in the end. He is very committed to the Black Dragon and loyal to [Kokonoi](https://anilist.co/character/170480/Kokonoi-Hajime), whom he considers his best friend. When he finds people he trusts, he devotes himself to them. He is brave, but will be willing to show his vulnerable side and open up.

__Height:__ 148 cm (past), 175 cm (present)

Hinata's younger brother. He very much resembles his father.

Naoto is a righteous individual who is also determined to also save his sister. He has a no-nonsense personality and is usually unamused by others' humorous advances. He is also willing to embrace far-fetched possibilities, such as the fact that Takemichi can time-travel, and even make his own hypotheses about it.

~!Before the first time travel, he died together with Hinata. However, after he was warned of his death by Hanagaki and was subsequently saved, he grew up to become a detective and ended up playing a key role in Hanagaki's ability to travel through time.!~ ~!Naoto is the key to activating Takemichi's supernatural time-travel ability. Whether in the past or present, as long as the two shake hands, Takemichi will be transferred to the present (if he is in the past), or the past (if he is in the present). He is also the only person who is aware of the consequences caused by Takemichi's time-traveling aside from Takemichi thus far.!~

__Height:__ 192cm

He is the former acting leader of Moebius following Osanai's defeat.

Hanma's single purpose is to find excitement, relieving his boredom by street violence. Hanma slowly sinks in to apathy since he was winning fights easily, without any resistance, that's why he sooner ally with [Kisaki Tetta](https://anilist.co/character/170483).

__Height:__ 150 cm
~![Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341/Manjirou-Sano)'s younger half-sister.!~~!Killed by [Tetta Kisaki](https://anilist.co/character/170483/Tetta-Kisaki).!~

__Height:__ 183 cm

Vice Captain of the Second Division of the Tokyo Manji Gang. The younger brother of [Yuzuha](https://anilist.co/character/170482/Yuzuha-Shiba) and the younger brother of [Taiju](https://anilist.co/character/167845/Taiju-Shiba), the leader of the 10th Generation Black Dragons.

Hakkai is shown to be a timid but friendly guy. When it comes to his personality he is nothing like his older brother Taiju who is disciplined and bloodlusted.

Hakkai has deep admiration for [Takashi Mitsuya](https://anilist.co/character/167841/Takashi-Mitsuya)
The younger sister of [Taiju Shiba](https://anilist.co/character/167845/Shiba-Taiju) and the elder sister of [Hakkai Shiba](https://anilist.co/character/167842/Shiba-Hakkai).

One of Takemichi's best friends in middle school.
~!
It's revealed that he is the person who pushed Takemichi in front of the train at the start of the story.!~

__Height:__ 174 cm Koko sees the world as a series of calculations. He acts solely in his own interests; every move of his is to benefit himself. He cozies up to those more powerful than he, but will turn his back on them the moment they lose their instrumentality. ~!Former tenth generation Black Dragons commander!~ ~!His goal was to collect 40 million yen to save his loved one, Akane but unfortunately, he was too late.!~

__Height:__ 172 cm

Vice captain of the 5th division in the Tokyo Manji Gang.
Older brother of [Mikey](https://anilist.co/character/145341/Manjirou-Sano).

__Height:__ 172 cm

A Tenjiku executive. Ran's younger brother.

~!He's a Bonten executive in the future.!~

__Height:__ 198 cm

The Black Dragon's 10th leader and [Hakkai's](https://anilist.co/character/167842/Hakkai-Shiba) and [Yuzuha's](https://anilist.co/character/170482/Yuzuha-Shiba) elder brother.

Taiju is brutal and abusive. He enjoys tormenting his opponents and has little care for others' wellbeing, even his own siblings'. He doesn't care who his opponent is regardless of gender. He is Catholic and has a cross tattooed on his back.

__Height:__ 183 cm

A Tenjiku executive. [Rindou](https://anilist.co/character/203563/Haitani-Rindou)'s elder brother.

~!He is a member of the S62 generation. He was one of Tenjiku’s 4 Heavenly Kings, and is a Bonten executive in the future.!~

Kisaki is the principal antagonist of Tokyo Revengers. He's especially known for rising to the top of the Toman at full speed. 

Kisaki is a ruthless, cunning, and ambitious individual who will stop at nothing to achieve his goals. Although average in stature, his power to rule with fear makes even those stronger than he obey him. The entirety of his actions in the entire story revolves around becoming the most powerful and influential criminal in Tokyo.

~! He is also known for organizing the murder of Hinata Tachibana many times. !~ ~!He is later ran over and killed by a truck after a long chase!~

title.native: ブルーロック VS. U-20 JAPAN

node.description:
__Birthplace:__ Chiba
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9")

Meguru Bachira is a contender in the Blue Lock Project who currently plays as a center forward for Spain’s FC Barcha during the Neo Egoist League. Bachira is a whimsical forward who plays instinctively.

__Height:__ 190 cm (6'3")

Contender for the Blue Lock Project. He attends Hakuho High School alongside [Reo Mikage](https://anilist.co/character/169394/Mikage-Reo). As a striker, Nagi's perfect ball control, flexible movements, and technical ability allow him to breathe life into even the most difficult or hopeless plays.

Nagi is a very lazy and unmotivated person with an outstanding aptitude for football. He's unnaturally talented, with amazing reflexes, good speed, and jumping skills. He has no interest in going pro or even playing at all at first. As long as he can get a decent job and keep living a lax life, he is content with doing nothing forever and often appears lethargic in his speech and body language. Introverted to a fault, he lives by himself in an apartment his parents pay for with only a pet cactus for company.

__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Second-year high school student at Ichinan High School in Saitama. Isagi grew up watching soccer and aspiring to be like [Noel Noa](https://anilist.co/character/268966), a forward for France's National Team. Due to this, he dreams of becoming the best striker in the world. In turn, Isagi played striker for his school soccer team, who was defeated in the Prefectural Finals by Matsukaze Kokou High. After this loss, Isagi is invited to participate in the Blue Lock Project, ranked 299th of 300 strikers, and is assigned to Team Z.

Isagi is easygoing and has a generally friendly, cheery personality, but his simple and innocent habits often get on the nerves of the people around him. As time goes on, Isagi develops a more assertive presence on and off the field, becoming the foundation for Team Z and garnering the respect of some of the best players in Blue Lock.

__Height:__ 177cm (5'10")

Hyoma Chigiri is a contender for the Blue Lock Project and member of Team Z. 

As a young child, he was thought of as a prodigy due to his incredible speed. However, he is now psychologically scarred by a life-changing injury during his first year of high school.

__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")

First-year high school student and contender for the Blue Lock Project. He is the younger brother of [Sae Itoshi](https://anilist.co/character/169397/Itoshi-Sae), a prodigy considered one of the best youth soccer players in the world. Rin once had the aspiration of being the greatest in the world alongside his brother, but after a disagreement, he became obsessed with beating his brother in football to demonstrate he can succeed without him.

Rin is a player who loves to play perfectly efficient football but isn’t hesitant to be daring and take surprising risks to fully embrace the live-or-die attitude he has grown fond of and appreciates. Whether on offense or defense, Rin's play style consists of him grasping the abilities of both his teammates and his opponents and forcing out their best plays and abilities. He either manipulates them in his efforts to score goals for himself or aims to crush them at their strongest.
__Height:__ 187 cm

__Height:__ 188 cm
__Team:__ Team Z

Rensuke Kunigami is very serious about his football career and training; he's always the first in the training room in the morning and the last to leave at night. Kunigami tends to get into arguments with [Raichi](https://anilist.co/character/169402/Raichi-Jingo), but is also the one who restrains him the most when he picks a fight with someone.

~!During the second selection Kunigami is eliminated from Blue Lock project, but afterwards gets a second chance through the Wild Card training!~

~!After Blue Lock vs. Japan U20 match, Kunigami gets back into Blue Lock project. His appearance changed a bit and his attitude too.!~

name.native: ミヒャエル カイザー

node.description:
__Birthplace:__ Berlin, Germany
__Height:__ 186 cm (6'1")

Michael Kaiser is a prodigy U-20 forward from Germany who plays for Bastard München during the Neo Egoist League as the team's ace and main striker. ~!He is a member of the New Generation World XI.!~

**Height:** 185 cm

Reo Mikage is the heir of the Mikage Corporation. Prior to entering Blue Lock, he was a student at an elite high school, the same school as [Seishiro Nagi](https://anilist.co/character/162969/Nagi-Seishirou).

__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11")

Sae Itoshi is regarded as the best player in Japan and is [Rin Itoshi](https://anilist.co/character/169395/Rin-Itoshi)'s older brother. He is a member of Re AL youth team and is regarded as one of the best youth players in the world. ~!He is a member of the New Generation World XI.!~

__Birthplace:__ Tokyo
__Height:__ 185 cm (6'1")

Ryuusei Shidou is a contender in the Blue Lock Project. ~!He was ranked #2 during the Third Selection and was initially chosen as the wildcard for the Blue Lock Eleven in their match against Japan’s U-20 team, but was instead selected by [Itoshi Sae](https://anilist.co/character/169397/Itoshi-Sae) to play for the U-20 side. He later stood out as one of the top players in the project. During the Neo Egoist League, he played as a center forward for France’s Paris X Gen. Following the conclusion of the 5th round, he was ranked 3rd overall and qualified as one of the 23 players for the new Japan U-20 team.!~

__Height:__ 189 cm (6'2")

General Director/Manager of the Blue Lock Project, handpicked to lead the project by [Anri Teieri](https://anilist.co/character/169405). Ego is introduced as a man who radiates ambition and confidence. His egotistical nature is undeniable, especially given his belief that only his methods can lead to Japan's victory in the World Cup.

Ego used to play football in his earlier career, with Noel Noa being his rival and former teammate.

__Birthplace:__ Stockholm, Sweden
__Height:__ 190 cm (6'2")
__Team:__ Japan U20 & ~!Ubers (NEL)!~
__Position:__ Center Back

Oliver Aiku is the captain and center-back of the Japan U-20 team.

__Height:__ 191 cm

Gagamaru was a forward who aspired to be the best in the world, along with the others of Blue Lock. When first arriving at Blue Lock, he was a member of Team Z during the First Selection.

__Height:__ 157cm (5'2")

Anri is a new member of the Japan Football Association. Sometime after the defeat of the Japanese National Team in the 2018 World Cup, Anri proposes the Blue Lock plan to the executives of the Japan Football Union to help Japan win the World Cup.

__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")

Hiori Yo one of friends that Isagi made before Third Selection begins

__Birthplace:__ Osaka
__Height:__ 183 cm (6'0")

Tabito Karasu is a contender in the Blue Lock Project. ~!He is ranked #3 during the Third Selection and later played as a defensive midfielder for the Blue Lock Eleven in their match against Japan’s U-20 team.!~

__Team:__ Team C; 3rd Clear Team (formerly); Blue Lock 11 (Left Wing)
__Position:__ Forward; Winger

He is currently ranked #5 out of the original 300 forwards chosen to be apart of the Blue Lock Project ~!and is currently starting as a winger for the Blue Lock Eleven team against the Japan U-20.!~

Yukimiya is highly confident in his own abilities, declaring himself the strongest player in Japan, when it comes to one-on-one battles. He is also a likable and charismatic personality, appearing to make friends easily, like with Nagi. In addition to this, Yukimiya likes to make banter even with his opponents, indicating a playful element to his personality.

Yukimiya claims that he is a pacifist, which forms part of his ego, since he sees the easiest and most peaceful way to score would be to do so himself. He is also inquisitive, often being the first to ask questions of Ego, about his selection criteria.

__Height:__ 168 cm (5'6")
__Team:__ Bastard München (NEL)
__Position:__ Wingback, Forward

Ranze Kurona is a participant of the Blue Lock project and plays for Bastard München during the Neo Egoist League. He typically plays as a post-player who can be easily utilized to exchange possession in the instance [Isagi](https://anilist.co/character/140856/Yoichi-Isagi) gets pressured.

__Height:__ 184 cm
__Team:__ Team Z

Raichi is the most hot-headed of the group and argues with just about everyone on everything, often to the point of needing to be restrained by [Kunigami](https://anilist.co/character/162214/Kunigami-Rensuke).

__Birthplace:__ Aichi
__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10")

Eita Otoya is a contender in the Blue Lock Project. 

~!He is ranked #4 during the Third Selection.!~

__Birthplace:__ Saitama Prefecture
__Height:__ 187 cm (6'2")

Zantetsu Tsurugi is a contender in the Blue Lock Project. ~!He was a member of Team V during the First Selection and remained among the selected contenders after the Second Selection. Known for his simplicity and remarkable speed, he played as a right winger for France’s Paris X Gen during the Neo Egoist League. Following the conclusion of the 5th round, he was ranked 19th overall and qualified as one of the 23 players selected for the U-20 World Cup.!~

Introverted to a fault, he lives by himself in an apartment his parents pay for with only a pet cactus for company.

sampleCharacters.name: Rin Itoshi
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 186 cm (6'1") First-year high school student and contender for the Blue Lock Project. He is the younger brother of [Sae Itoshi](https://anilist.co/character/169397/Itoshi-Sae), a prodigy considered one of the best youth soccer players in the world. Rin once had the aspiration of being the greatest in the world alongside his brother, but after a disagreement, he became obsessed with beating his brother in football to demonstrate he can succeed without him. Rin is a player who loves to play perfectly efficient football but isn’t hesitant to be daring and take surprising risks to fully embrace the live-or-die attitude he has grown fond of and appreciates. Whether on offense or defense, Rin's play style consists of him grasping the abilities of both his teammates and his opponents and forcing out their best plays and abilities. He either manipulates them in his efforts to score goals for himself or aims to crush them at their strongest.

sampleCharacters.name: Michael Kaiser
sampleCharacters.description: __Birthplace:__ Berlin, Germany __Height:__ 186 cm (6'1") Michael Kaiser is a prodigy U-20 forward from Germany who plays for Bastard München during the Neo Egoist League as the team's ace and main striker. ~!He is a member of the New Generation World XI.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Reo Mikage
sampleCharacters.description: **Height:** 185 cm Reo Mikage is the heir of the Mikage Corporation. Prior to entering Blue Lock, he was a student at an elite high school, the same school as [Seishiro Nagi](https://anilist.co/character/162969/Nagi-Seishirou).

sampleCharacters.name: Sae Itoshi
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") Sae Itoshi is regarded as the best player in Japan and is [Rin Itoshi](https://anilist.co/character/169395/Rin-Itoshi)'s older brother. He is a member of Re AL youth team and is regarded as one of the best youth players in the world. ~!He is a member of the New Generation World XI.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Ryuusei Shidou
sampleCharacters.description: __Birthplace:__ Tokyo __Height:__ 185 cm (6'1") Ryuusei Shidou is a contender in the Blue Lock Project. ~!He was ranked #2 during the Third Selection and was initially chosen as the wildcard for the Blue Lock Eleven in their match against Japan’s U-20 team, but was instead selected by [Itoshi Sae](https://anilist.co/character/169397/Itoshi-Sae) to play for the U-20 side. He later stood out as one of the top players in the project. During the Neo Egoist League, he played as a center forward for France’s Paris X Gen. Following the conclusion of the 5th round, he was ranked 3rd overall and qualified as one of the 23 players for the new Japan U-20 team.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Jinpachi Ego
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 189 cm (6'2") General Director/Manager of the Blue Lock Project, handpicked to lead the project by [Anri Teieri](https://anilist.co/character/169405). Ego is introduced as a man who radiates ambition and confidence. His egotistical nature is undeniable, especially given his belief that only his methods can lead to Japan's victory in the World Cup. Ego used to play football in his earlier career, with Noel Noa being his rival and former teammate.

sampleCharacters.name: Oliver Aiku
sampleCharacters.description: __Birthplace:__ Stockholm, Sweden __Height:__ 190 cm (6'2") __Team:__ Japan U20 & ~!Ubers (NEL)!~ __Position:__ Center Back Oliver Aiku is the captain and center-back of the Japan U-20 team.

sampleCharacters.name: Gin Gagamaru
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 191 cm Gagamaru was a forward who aspired to be the best in the world, along with the others of Blue Lock. When first arriving at Blue Lock, he was a member of Team Z during the First Selection.

sampleCharacters.name: Anri Teieri
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 157cm (5'2") Anri is a new member of the Japan Football Association. Sometime after the defeat of the Japanese National Team in the 2018 World Cup, Anri proposes the Blue Lock plan to the executives of the Japan Football Union to help Japan win the World Cup.

sampleCharacters.name: You Hiori
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 183 cm (6'0") Hiori Yo one of friends that Isagi made before Third Selection begins

sampleCharacters.name: Jingo Raichi
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 184 cm __Team:__ Team Z Raichi is the most hot-headed of the group and argues with just about everyone on everything, often to the point of needing to be restrained by [Kunigami](https://anilist.co/character/162214/Kunigami-Rensuke).

sampleCharacters.name: Eita Otoya
sampleCharacters.description: __Birthplace:__ Aichi __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") Eita Otoya is a contender in the Blue Lock Project. ~!He is ranked #4 during the Third Selection.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Zantetsu Tsurugi
sampleCharacters.description: __Birthplace:__ Saitama Prefecture __Height:__ 187 cm (6'2") Zantetsu Tsurugi is a contender in the Blue Lock Project. ~!He was a member of Team V during the First Selection and remained among the selected contenders after the Second Selection. Known for his simplicity and remarkable speed, he played as a right winger for France’s Paris X Gen during the Neo Egoist League. Following the conclusion of the 5th round, he was ranked 19th overall and qualified as one of the 23 players selected for the U-20 World Cup.!~

node.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 170 cm
__Rank:__ Regular
__Position:__ Light Bearer

Khun Aguero Agnis is a E-Rank Regular from Khun Family, and is often referred to simply as "Khun". He is a best friend of [Twenty-Fifth Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Bam), one of the main protagonists of Tower of God.

Khun relies heavily on his master intellect, however, this is not his only strong field. He also has exceptional physical attributes and is a skilled Light Bearer. His powers in combat cannot be denied.

__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 168 cm (Part 1), 180 cm (Part II)
__Rank:__ Irregular
__Position:__ Wave Controller
__Born:__  ~!Floor of Death!~__Occupation:__  ~!FUG Slayer Candidate!~

Twenty-Fifth Baam is an Irregular and one of the main protagonists of Tower of God. Bam entered in search of his best friend [Rachel](https://anilist.co/character/135466/Rachel), and after passing Headon's test he was deemed worthy to climb the Tower.

In Part I, he is a highly empathetic and caring young man, understanding little of life, having had virtually no contact with people before meeting Rachel and later entering the Tower. He hates loneliness and other people's loneliness. He is considered very naive and knows little about the Tower. During Part I, his only reason for climbing the Tower is to be with Rachel.

In Part II:
~!
He was forced to join FUG, and received then the name of Jue Viole Grace (쥬 비올레 그레이스), the Slayer Candidate, to keep his real identity hidden. As Viole, he is far more violent. He now has friends to protect and will not hesitate to fight if it means protecting them. He now completely understands that in order to climb the Tower, he must be pre-emptive and prepared to engage in combat and eradicate all opposition. He's become more introverted, rarely ever speaking or displaying any signs of emotion. He's also quite cold and calculating, interacting with others only out of necessity and will take advantage of a situation to defeat his opponents.

Later in the Part as FUG's hold on him weakens, he begins to be more expressive and talkative. Later, when he officially meets with Khun and Rak for the first time in seven years, he smiles happily and embraces them, showing that his original personality that he had hidden away to protect himself from FUG's influence was resurfacing.
!~


In Part III:
~!
He is completely back to his normal self, with the addition of some improvements in areas such as confidence. He additionally dropped the 'Viole' look and sticks with an updated 'Baam' look. He is still often called both Baam and Viole now. He now goes through new questions such as what to do when he can't save everyone, and old questions, such as why everyone can't just get along, but he is more accepting of things than before, all the while continually fighting stronger enemies and becoming stronger.
!~

alternative: ラーク・レクレイシャー

node.description:
__Species:__ Wraithraiser, ~!Native One!~ __Height:__ 3m (Decompressed) __Rank:__ Regular C-Rank __Position:__ Spear Bearer Rak Wraithraiser is a Regular. He unwillingly teamed up with [Baam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Baam) and [Khun](https://anilist.co/character/84781/Khun-Aguero-Agnis) during the first test on the Second Floor and passed other tests with them. He was selected for the Spear Bearer position. He is a large and powerful warrior and a very confident individual.
Rak is originally a 3 meter tall creature, but after he mocked the Ranker [Yu Han Sung](https://anilist.co/character/141286/Sung-Yu-Han), the Second Floor Test Director, his body was shrunken by them. He eventually found out how to get back to his original size. As a being who can control their body size, he is a Compression Licenser.
He is a direct descendant of the Native One, a type of being that is able to rule over the elements in the Tower.
Rak doesn't come off as particularly smart; he thinks he's superior to almost everyone else and so refers to other people as "turtles". He occasionally calls himself "Rakleader" when he is feeling particularly full of himself, although Khun may be to blame for indulging him. He tries to make himself appear tough, although he's actually a bit of a baby sometimes. However, he does seem to have a little of a caring side in him.

alternative: エンドロシ・ザハード

node.description:
__Height:__ 167 cm

Endorsi Jahad is a Regular and one of Jahad's Princesses, currently climbing the Tower. Among Regulars, Endorsi is unmatched in terms of physical ability. Among the Jahad's Princesses, she is fairly warm and more human.

Her parents weren't around when she was born. She was then adopted by a couple from the Middle Area before she became a princess. Later, her adoptive parents were killed by Snake Charmer.

Her character concept is that of a 'Normal modern girl' taking great care of her looks, stressed about her weight, wanting to hear she is pretty while acting confident. A girl who is yet to mature fully.

Endorsi doesn't believe in being friends with a guy at first and says that guys and girls cannot be friends and can only be boyfriend and girlfriend and later states that she is not allowed to date anyone because she is a Princess of Jahad, but later on she catches feelings for [Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Baam) and calls Bam her boyfriend.

Ha Yuri Jahad, more commonly known as Yu​ri Jahad (lacking her family name), is a High Ranker and Princess from the Ha Family. Notably, she is one of the most famous Princesses and therefore highly favored, with much political influence throughout The Tower.

~!She is the owner of Black March and Green April, two of the 13 Month Series. She is the first Princess to own two 13 Months at the same time since Garam Jahad. Notably, she is one of the most famed Princesses, and perhaps one of the most favored.!~

__Species:__ Red Witch
__Height:__ 168 cm 
__Rank:__ Regular
__Position:__ Wave Controller, Scout, Guide

Hwaryun is a quiet person who says little and she has a gloomy and ominous aura. She is also quite manipulative.

In Part II, she's depicted as mischievous and teasing, as she clearly mocked the Viole impostor and repeatedly called him "Pig". She almost always smiles in mischief and probably a little bit of arrogance. She also tends to be extremely blunt, caring very little about other peoples' feelings; though this could be considered her way of spurring a person on. This leads her to seem very harsh.

Hwaryun is Viole's Guide but is also the Guide for FUG's Rankers notably Ha Jinsung. ~!It was revealed that she went into the Floor of Death first, instructing another Red-haired lady to lead the way for Yuri and Khun's team.!~

__Species:__ Human
__Born:__ Outside
__Height:__ 195 cm
__Rank:__ Irregular, High Ranker #4 (Currently)
__Position:__ Fisherman
__Occupation:__ Wolhaiksong (Vice Captain)

Urek Mazino is an Irregular, currently 4th in Rank. He was the strongest active Ranker before [Jahad](https://anilist.co/character/126030/Jahad) became active once again. He is also the most recent person to be part of the Top 5 High Rankers inside the Tower.

He is considered to be on the same level as Phantaminum by weaker Rankers, however, his true rank is almost impossible to determine in terms of the Top 4 ranks because the top 2 Rankers are inactive and thus, cannot be compared with Urek. He mentioned to [Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/TwentyFifth-Bam) on the 43rd Floor that they would meet again later on the 77th Floor, then left the floor. His current location is unknown.

Urek is said to have a ruthless personality, leading him to be respected by all those who dare call themselves men and at the same time seems to be disliked by seemingly every woman he meets. He is also shown to be extremely confident to the point of arrogance, often ridiculing the efforts of those who were no match for him. Despite his ruthlessness and boastful nature, he still wants to help others and friends in need. He will also help strangers if he thinks they are "worthy" to be helped. He respects one's courage, determination, and nobility.

Lero-Ro is a former Examiner of the Second Floor. He is an exceptionally strong Ranker, to the point that even Quant, also a former Test Administrator (and a haughty one), would constantly boast about his strength. He was supposedly the strongest Second Floor Test Administrator and is particularly skilled in the use of Shinsoo. He was also the Light Bearer position instructor. He is fairly old, older than Yuri Zahard, as he stated that Anak Zahard didn't live up to a Princess's chaotic expectations like Yuri Zahard did, whom he met when they were both Regulars. He and Quant are awkwardly described as a "Set Menu", explained by the fact that Lero-Ro and Quant climbed the Tower together like a team. He is apparently quite famous, and he took over 300 years to climb the Tower.

__Species:__ Human
__Height:__ 167cm
__Position:__ Scout

Hatsu (하츠, Hahcheu; or "Hatz") is a Regular and a "devoutly" practising swordsman. He is a quiet and calm warrior, who has been making good progress in the tests merely by doing exactly what each test entails. 

~!He teamed up with [Anaak Jahad](https://anilist.co/character/135470/Anaak-Jahad) and [Shibisu](https://anilist.co/character/137957/Shibisu) during the first test on the 2nd Floor and later signed Khun's friend list.!~

~!He was last seen on the 52nd Floor having helped [Bam](https://anilist.co/character/84769/Twentyfifth-Bam) and his allies.!~

Anaak is introduced in the second floor, where she forms a team with Shibisu and Hatz.

~!She introduces herself as one of Jahad's Princesses, but it's later revealed that she's actually the daughter of the real Anaak Jahad, who was impregnated by her lover and ran into hiding. Though she is only a demi-princess because of the diluted Jahad's blood in her, she used to possess two of the 13 Month Series at one point; something only a few Princesses have accomplished. She is climbing the Tower for revenge.!~

__Species:__ Human
__Rank:__ Extra

Rachel, also known as Michelle Light was Baam's best and only friend as she was the only one to visit him in his "cave". She longs to see the stars which is one of the fabled rewards waiting at the top of the Tower, because she "fears the Night".
~!Like Baam she is an Irregular.!~

Ja Wangnan aspires to be the king of the whole Tower. He values his determination in life more than anyone else's desires. He plans to scale up the Tower's Floors and reach the true top of the Tower, unlike those who have given up.

Jin-Seong Ha is a High Ranker of the Ha Family and a member of FUG. Jinsung has a carefree and fun-loving attitude, although this also serves as a mask to hide his true intentions. Since meeting Baam, his character has mellowed slightly to the point where he feels regret at the FUG's treatment of Baam.
As a member of the Ha Family and one of the top 100 High Rankers, Jinsung is an incredibly powerful High Ranker, extremely skilled with martial arts and incredibly physically powerful, his status heightening the standards one would expect of him.

Additionally, even the Elders and Slayers of FUG are wary of angering him, speaking volumes about his strength, with Khel Hellam commenting it was a waste to lose someone as powerful as Jinsung and Kallavan noted that Jinsung is far stronger than Karaka, one of the Slayers. In fact, he is such a monster that Hwa Ryun stated that even a Slayer would have trouble against him in a serious fight.

Shibisu is a D-rank Regular. He is relatively weak, yet possesses a great ability to deduce and an intellect on par with Khun's. Nonetheless, he made it past all of the tests on the Second Floor, where he was assigned the Scout position and is now climbing the Tower as the leader of his team.

Phonsekal Lauroe is a Regular and a talented Wave Controller of the Eurasia Family. He loves to sleep and goes everywhere with blanket and his pillows. Despite his sloth, he is an exceptional Wave Controller, capable of firing powerful long-range blasts.

Ran Khun is a Regular currently climbing the Tower. He was formerly Khun's teammate and was also formerly a member of the FUG team created for Jue Viole Grace. He often describes situations or people that are troublesome as 'annoying'. After the events of the Workshop Battle, he formed into a new team with Khun's direction. He is also from the same branch of the Khun family as Mascheny Jahad.

Ehwa Yeon, known by some as the "Yeon Family's Flare", is a member of the Yeon Family one of the 10 Great Families. She is a Regular climbing with the rest of her team, having recently participated in the Workshop Battle.

Yu Han Sung is an Advanced Ranker and the former Test Director of the Second Floor. Notably, he is a key member of FUG in taking Viole to the top. He is the main antagonist of Part I. He is a well known ranker partly because he rejected becoming a High Ranker.

Headon is the Guardian of the First Floor and is the caretaker of the Tower. He has an appearance reminiscent of a white rabbit because of his long ears.

Headon talks in a friendly tone, but has been shown to have a cruel and manipulative streak. He presents his ideas and opinions in a logical and pragmatic manner, but his goals and desires themselves are not understood. He is perfectly willing to manipulate dozens of lives and create the nucleus of civil unrest to attain his mysterious goal.

Although most Administrators normally stay on their Floors, Headon seems to be the only Administrator with the ability to visit other Floors of the Tower. It is said that Headon is the most experienced Administrator of the Tower. Although that only means he was the first Administrator Zahard met and therefore the first one to carry out the roles of a Administrator, that doesn't mean he's the oldest.
Karaka is a Slayer in FUG. His secret hideout is located on the 97th Floor.
Serena Rinnen is a Regular who passed most of the tests on the Second Floor and was assigned the Scout position.

alternative: エヴァン・エドロック

node.description: Evan Edrok is a High Ranker as well the Chief Guide of Zahard Royalty, which is a unique position in the Tower. He always seems to follow his partner, Ha Yuri Zahard.

__Sobriquet__: Aloof Wave
__Rank__: 14

Po Bidau Gustang is the head of the Po Bidau Family, one of the 10 Great Warriors and the first living being to systematically record Shinsoo. Po Bidau Gustang is the Tower’s most famous Wave Controller and writer. Excluding the eccentrics within The Workshop, he probably knows the most about The Tower. He is shown to be an arrogant individual, with such great reputation and influence in his family, that even his family members think he has omniscient intellect.
Quant Blitz is a Ranker. He instructed the Scout position while he was a Test Admin on the Second Floor.

Khun Maschenny Jahad is a Top 100 High Rankers in the Tower from the Khun Family and the owner of the Yellow May, one of the 13 Month Series. She is the only Jahad's Princesses in the Khun Family to be awarded with a 13 Months. She is a direct descendant of Khun Edahn and Khun Maschenny.

__Height:__ 162 cm

He is a founding member and the leader of Tokyo Manji Gang.
 
Mikey is usually a carefree teenager who loves to joke and play pranks around those he considers his close friends. He cares for them greatly and is determined to protect their honor. He rarely shows any sign of weakness, as he believes himself to be the foundation and support for Toman, and if the pillar himself were to display weakness, Toman would also be weakened.

~!Younger brother of [Shinichiro](https://anilist.co/character/221297/Shinichirou-Sano), older half brother of [Emma](https://anilist.co/character/171924/Emma-Sano) and younger "adoptive" brother of [Izana](https://anilist.co/character/170484/Izana-Kurokawa)!~

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

__Grade:__ 3rd Year
__Positions:__ Founder, Mascot, and Official Deer of the Deer Club, Part-Time Deer at Hino Zoo.

Noko Shikanoko is a unique human-deer hybrid and the founder and mascot of the Deer Club at Hino Minami High School.

She is a transfer student who becomes the best friend, classmate, and clubmate of [Torako Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330137/Torako-Koshi).

__Grade:__ 3rd Year (Formerly 2nd Year).
__Positions:__ President of the Deer Club, Head of the Student Council, Delinquent Gang Member (Formerly).
__Relatives:__ [Anko Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330138/Anko-Koshi) (Younger Sister).

Torako Koshi is a student at Hino Minami High School, and a highly respected one at that; being considered by many to be a "perfect girl". She is the classmate, best friend, and clubmate of [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko).

Wanting to change for the better after her past of being a delinquent, Koshi vowed to renew her ways. Within a year, she had become the complete opposite, becoming an honor student who's athletic, kind, helpful, and adored by all. However, after meeting Shikanoko Noko, she found out the deer girls chaotic actions makes some of her delinquent-like traits slip out more often than she would like to admit, threatening to expose her dark past to their classmates and ruin her reputation. 

Excluding the narrator, Torako is the one of few characters to break the fourth wall, along with being able to recognize the absurdity of Shikanoko Noko's antics. On top of being an honors student, she is also very passionate about her likes and hobbies - having a collection of stuffed toys she kisses before going to bed, calling out to several shonen manga characters for help when met with difficult situations, and displaying her knack for interior design. She is also very easily embarrassed, often heavily blushing from romantic gestures like love letters, or inquiries about her love life along with getting embarrassed from situations she puts herself in and can easily swept by her own emotions.

__Grade:__ 1st Year
__Position:__ "Deer-In-Training" of the Deer Club

Meme Bashame is a new student at Hino Minami High School and the 4th official member of the Deer Club. Bashame joined the Deer Club because of her newfound idolization of [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko), who had offered Bashame kindness and deer crackers: saving Bashame from starving on their first day of high school. Bashame hopes of learning to become a full-fledged deer during her stay in the deer club under Nokotan, viewing her as a sensei of sorts and having somewhat of a passive obsession over them.

Bashame can be described as laidback and sluggish, having no problem falling asleep anywhere and everywhere at anytime, usually ending up dozing on the cold concrete floor. Bashame miraculously never gets sick from this. Bashame also is notable for having illeism, a tendency to refer to oneself in third person when speaking, and a fascination with rice, as Bashame often cooks, eats, and grows rice in the Deer Club, more times being seen with rice than not. This could be from Bashame's passion for self-sufficiency, or Bashame may just really love rice. Bashame also tends to eat this rice excessively, many times being seen with a towering amount of rice in a bowl, much to the shock of other characters. Bashame also cannot whistle.

__Height:__ 132 cm
__Grade:__ 3rd Year
__Positions:__ Vice President of the Student Council, Honorary Member of the Deer Club

Neko Nekoyamada is a student at Hino Minami High School, and the self-proclaimed rival of the Deer Club. She is very catlike, both in appearance with her hair stylized into neat cat ear-like cones, and in personality with wanting to be praised and seen as superior by her fellow classmates. Due to her always being outshined by both [Torako Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330137/Torako-Koshi) and the Deer Club's extreme popularity, Neko has the goal to discover Koshitan's weakness and overthrow her, and to get the deer club disbanded, so she can finally be in the spotlight and become the President of the Student Council. 

She is known to be hot-headed and competitive and likes to be organized and get work done in the student council, tending to do a lot of work. She is easily influenced by praise, completely forgetting her goal in mind and becoming very happy and gloatful about it. She also seems to be one of the only other characters than Koshitan that is put off by the unpredictability of [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko) and frequently confused at the shenanigans they cause. Neko is also extremely attached to Tsuchi despite her initial fear of them, and often displays motherly qualities when thinking about them. She also owns a personal stepstool, in order to help compensate for her noticeably short height.

__Grade:__ 1st Year
__Position:__ "Self-Proclaimed Sister Caretaker" of the Deer Club

Anko is a new student at Hino Minami High School, the 3rd official member of the Deer Club, and the younger sister of [Torako Koshi](https://anilist.co/character/330137/Torako-Koshi). She is best known for her sister complex towards their older sibling; being highly obsessed with everything regarding her sister and making it her personal life goal to be always by her sister's side 24/7, much to the latter's dismay and embarrassment. She will not hesitate to try and outright assassinate anyone who goes as far as to even just stand within near proximity of Koshitan, typically having a dark and sinister aura whenever somebody starts to act all chummy with them. Anko is also known to be adept at arming herself with her collection of kunai when faced with possible "threats" and in setting traps in her victims' surroundings. 

The only time she has made an exception to anyone else getting close to her sister was when she tried killing [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko), only to see, much to her surprise, that her sister deeply cares for Nokotan. Thus, she decided that someone else, for once, was also worthy of supporting Koshitan as well, just as long as it was together.

__Grade:__ 2nd Year
__Position:__ Secretary of the Student Council

Kinu Tanukikoji is a student at Hino Minami High School and a complete girlfailure, being extremely timid and overthinking almost everything. Whenever she makes a simple mistake like accidentally getting papers in the wrong order, she mentally spirals and goes into a state of panic, even going as far as coming up with imaginary disastrous events that would (but actually won't) unfold from her minor mistake and attempting to commit seppuku. 

Kinu is also childhood friends with [Chiharu Tsubameya](https://anilist.co/character/337287/Chiharu-Tsubameya).

__Grade:__ 2nd Year
__Position:__ Treasurer of the Student Council

Chiharu Tsubameya is a student at Hino Minami High School. She initially appears to be a much calmer and more collected girl, having a cool and laid-back personality. So laid-back, in fact, that it is extremely difficult to figure out what she is thinking. She is known to unconsciously give glares and almost completely ignore what others are offering or saying to her. The exception of this rule is [Noko Shikanoko](https://anilist.co/character/330136/Noko-Shikanoko), of which she treasures and loves any small gift or attention from, due to her being a massive fan of them. 

Despite appearing somewhat distant on the outside, she has been shown to care for others outside of Nokotan, such as when she felt bad for mistreating [Koshitan](https://anilist.co/character/330137/Torako-Koshi) due to her having felt envious that she could speak so casually with Nokotan, seeing her as an acquaintance who helped break the ice and helped her gather the courage to speak to their idol.

She also has an older brother that she lives with at his Cafe, [Yoshiharu Tsubameya](https://anilist.co/character/342963/Yoshiharu-Tsubameya), and is childhood friends with [Kinu Tanukikoji](https://anilist.co/character/337286).
The owner and sole barista of Swallow Cafe. He is the older brother of [Tsubameya Chiharu](https://anilist.co/character/337287/Chiharu-Tsubameya).

node.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm (5'4")

Ais Wallenstein, also known as the Sword Princess, is a First-Class Adventurer and a key member of the Loki Familia. Among the small fraction of First-Class Adventurers, she is considered one of the strongest.

__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Bell Cranel is the captain of the Hestia Familia. Bell was raised by his grandfather in a rural farming village deep within the mountains near the labyrinth city Orario. He had heard and read many stories about heroes from his grandfather, forming his dream of aspiring to be a mighty one himself. After his grandfather's death, he took it upon himself to leave the village, traveling to the land of Orario to fulfill his dreams. Upon his arrival in the city, Bell attempted to enter numerous Familia, but was rejected by each one. [Hestia](https://anilist.co/character/87654/Hestia), a Goddess, unable to find members willing to join her Familia, asked him if he'd like to become the first member of her Familia. Bell gladly accepted, and so started his new life, finally with a Goddess' blessing.

Bell is a kind, straightforward, brave, yet shy boy who desires to be a hero like the ones he grew up reading about. He cares deeply for the people around him, especially his Goddess, Hestia, and his Familia. He considers them like family due to the death of his grandfather. Bell's goals didn't start out pure, as he wanted to be an adventurer in hopes of picking up girls, even thinking of starting a harem. However, after his experience with [Ais](https://anilist.co/character/87655/Wallenstein-Ais) and [Bete](https://anilist.co/character/122632/Loga-Bete), Bell seems to have forgone that dream and fell in love with Ais Wallenstein. He became determined to grow stronger so that he could be someone that could stand beside her. Ais saved Bell in an incident with a minotaur and that event made Bell fall in love with her and have fear of Minotaurs.

__Race:__ God
__Height:__ 140 cm (4'7")
__Affiliation:__ Hestia Familia

Hestia is an energetic, kind goddess who sees potential in [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell). She is a hard worker, and works jobs to support the two while Bell goes off to the dungeon. Hestia tends to be shown as very petty and gets jealous easily when girls, namely [Aiz](https://anilist.co/character/87655/Wallenstein-Ais), show interest in Bell, because she is deeply in love with him, or they are the reason for his strength growth. Despite seeming mature and dependable toward Bell, Hestia is in truth, a lazy goddess, as she couldn't get a job or put effort into work. After descending to the Lower World, Hestia was taken care of by her friend [Hephaestus](https://anilist.co/character/142544/Hephaestus). Soon after, she was asked to live on her own after she kept freeloading off of Hephaestus' familia and was given a room at an abandoned church. Hestia tried to create her own familia, but wasn't able to recruit anyone. After failing to recruit for the 50th time, she noticed Bell and decided to secretly follow him. Hestia found out that Bell had been trying to enter a familia, but was rejected multiple times and seemed to be in the same boat. Hestia then took the chance to recruit him, which Bell happily agreed upon; becoming the first member of her familia. She took Bell to a bookstore, the location she already decided beforehand, and granted her Falna to her first dependent.

__Race:__ Elf
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")

Ryuu Lion is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility.

Ryuu was a member of a family that cared for the sacred tree in their home forest of Ryumilua. As time passed, she began to think that beautiful Elves were the ugliest of all people, due to seeing her fellow Elves' behavior toward those of other races. No matter how much she tried to forget it, once she began thinking about it, the thought firmly planted itself in her mind. Eventually, the thought became enough to make her decide to leave the forest.

Ryuu is calm and stoic but also cares deeply for her friends. When a person related to her or her friends are in danger or in need of help, she is always ready to step in and help no matter the cost. Like many Elves, Ryuu is selective with who may touch her. However, she has been advised by [Alise](https://anilist.co/character/288478) to not let go of a man that was able to grab her hands, and began to follow [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860) with her eyes. Unlike most Elves, she doesn't bear the same hatred towards the Crozzo family or their magic swords for their role in the destruction of the forests the Elves lived in, stating that the event took place many years ago and that her village wasn't directly affected. 

~!After arriving in Orario, Ryuu became an adventurer known as Gale, belonging to the Astraea Familia. She was caught in a trap set by Evilus and all of her fellow Familia members were murdered. Overcome with vengeance, she persuaded [Astraea](https://anilist.co/character/288476/Astraea) to leave Orario as she didn't want her to see her revenge. After that, she single-handedly destroyed the Rudra Familia as a part of her rampage and those associated with Evilus through various trickery, traps, and assassinations, causing her to be branded as a fugitive as a result of the ensuing chaos. Her revenge finally fulfilled, she collapsed in an alley where she nearly succumbed to her injuries. Fortunately, she was discovered by Syr and nursed back to health by [Mia Grand](https://anilist.co/character/122206/Grand-Mia). Ever since then, she has joined the Hostess of Fertility.!~

__Race:__ Renard
__Height:__ 156 cm (5'1")

Sanjouno Haruhime is a member of the Hestia Familia and a former member of the Ishtar Familia. Haruhime grew up as a dignified young lady of a noble family in the Far East. Living in solitude, her home was like a cage and she had no friends. At some point, children of the Takemikazuchi Familia, with the approval of their God, started taking her outside at night to play with them. Sometime later, someone framed her for eating an offering, which angered her father so much that he disowned her and a Pallum guest offered to take her away. As they were traveling, they were attacked by monsters and the Pallum ran away, leaving Haruhime behind. She survived, but was later captured by bandits and sold to a brothel in Orario. While heading there, she caught the eye of [Ishtar](https://anilist.co/character/146789/Ishtar), who bought her. Haruhime became a member of the Ishtar Familia, where she was forced to work as a prostitute, until the Familia disbanded.

Haruhime is a gentle, timid, well-mannered, and extremely kind girl. She is respectful of everyone she meets and is eager to help when given the chance. Having grown up mostly isolated and later kept hidden by the Ishtar Familia, Haruhime has experienced quite a sheltered life. And as such, even minor things will excite her. Haruhime developed a love of reading at a young age, as it was her way of escaping her loneliness. She has a fondness for fairy tales, particularly ones where the hero saves a damsel in distress. When she was made to work as a prostitute, she wished that a hero would come and save her like in those stories. As time went on, however, she convinced herself that she wouldn't be saved since she believed that her profession made her unworthy of rescue. However, Haruhime's view on this changed after [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) saved her regardless of her beliefs. Though she has never had to fend for herself, Haruhime displays an unusual sense of bravery when those she cares for are threatened. When [Wiene](https://anilist.co/character/146907/Wiene) was in danger, Haruhime leaped off a building in pursuit of her and stood up to [Bete](https://anilist.co/character/122632/Loga-Bete) in order to give Bell enough time to escort Wiene to safety.

While working as a prostitute, Haruhime would foam at the mouth and collapse whenever she saw a naked man. Due to this, she is still a virgin, but is unaware of the fact.

__Race:__ Pallum
__Height:__ 110 cm (3'7")

Liliruca Arde is a member of the Hestia Familia. Originally a member of the Soma Familia, she converted to the Hestia Familia after securing her freedom after the War Game. Lili was born to Hobbit parents belonging to the Soma Familia, making her a member of the Familia from birth. However, her parents didn't look after her and ordered her to earn money for them instead. A while later, her parents were killed in the dungeon, leaving her to fend for herself. The Soma Familia didn't take care of her and bullied her, making her lonely and isolated. To earn money, she tried to be an adventurer, but didn't have the talent, eventually switching to being a supporter. As a supporter, she was constantly looked down on by those she partied with, fueling the hatred of adventurers inside of her. After a while, Lili decided to run away from the Soma Familia and become a normal citizen. However, the Soma Familia found her and inflicted misery on the old couple who took care of her, destroying their store and stealing money. She began to hate Soma himself, wondering why he created a Familia if he wasn't going to take care of it. From that time on, Lili began using her hatred of adventurers as an excuse to trick and steal from them. 

She also treated Bell the same way, however, his actions repeatedly caused her to question her own attitude. After she is saved by Bell, she becomes much closer to him and develops romantic feelings for him. Lili often uses her experience to gather information or do jobs that Bell and the other members of the Hestia Familia would be unable to do properly. She is also frequently amazed at how Bell seems to constantly get himself involved in trouble, yet she still cooperates with him in whatever he does.

Lili is regarded as the "brains" of the Familia, being that she is the most capable when it comes to developing battle plans and strategies. She advised Bell and Welf to travel to the eighteenth floor when they were trapped in the dungeon, and she was crucial in forming the Hestia Familia's plan of attack for the War Game. Lili also possesses a strong insight, forged through her time as a thief, as she was able to pick up Finn Deimne's speech patterns, mannerisms, and character after only one meeting with him.

__Race:__ God
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7"), ~!162 cm (5'4") (as Syr)!~
__Affiliation:__ Freya Familia, ~!Hostess of Fertility (as Syr), Maria's Orphanage (as Syr)!~

Freya Is the head of the Freya Familia. Long ago, Hera, at the request of [Zeus](https://anilist.co/character/142554/Zeus), asked Freya for help in their goal to save the world. Freya made her a challenge, telling her that she would help her if she won. Having lost the challenge, Freya was forced to stay in Orario as part of the deal, in addition to losing several members of her Familia as a result. Some time later, Freya met a girl named Syr. After telling her that she would rescue her, Freya asked the girl what she wanted. Hearing that she wanted to be like her, Freya decided to offer her a deal, which she accepted.

Freya is flirtatious, loves to tease, and has an unending appetite for talented adventurers. She seeks the best and most talented adventurers and will obtain them no matter the cost. She holds an obsession over [Bell Cranel](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) and actively does anything in her power to see him grow as an adventurer. Freya doesn't like to be bound by anyone, though she doesn't wish to become an arrogant ruler either. She is very impatient. She constantly interferes with Bell's activities knowing it might kill him but wanting to see him grow as fast as possible. At the same time, she is just as willing to help Bell to see him grow, such as when she gave up a grimoire just to speed up his progress. Freya is intrigued by his resistance to being charmed, making her want him even more. She doesn't take kindly to others trying to claim what she wants, as she invaded and ruthlessly destroyed the Entertainment District with her Familia when [Ishtar](https://anilist.co/character/146789/Ishtar) tried to claim Bell and ended up sending her back to heaven. She said that she won't let any woman other than herself have him. She was also shown to show a little jealousy when Bell trained with [Ais](https://anilist.co/character/87655/Wallenstein-Ais) the first time and when Bell and Ais danced at Apollo's Banquet. Despite her usual straightforward method of acquiring those she takes a fancy to, Freya has decided to watch over Bell instead, stating that she could claim him whenever she wanted. Usually, she stays in her room in Babel, not making public appearances, but has recently started to come out to gather information about Bell or see him in person at the God's Banquets and Denatuses.

~!Freya obtained [Syr](https://anilist.co/character/340415/Hrn) name and the ability to transform into her, while in exchange the girl obtained the name Horn and a magic that allows her to transform into Freya.!~

~!As Syr, she shows a cheerful and kind demeanor, normally she is lightly mischievous, and at times, scary. She enjoys teasing Bell and others close to her, but is weak to getting teased herself, which usually ends up with her blushing beet red. She is kind, but tends to take advantage of others, usually to raise her family business, or avoid getting in trouble. She sometimes takes days off to care for the children at Maria's Orphanage in Daedalus Street.!~

__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")
__Affiliation:__ Hestia Familia • Takemikazuchi Familia (temporary leave)
__Level:__ 2
__Skills:__ Yatanokurogarasu • Yatanoshirogarasu
__Magic:__ Futsunomitama
__Weapon:__ Kotetsu • Chizan • Shunsan • Shakuya

Yamato Mikoto is a member of the Hestia Familia and the Takemikazuchi Familia, having converted to aid the former during the War Game. Mikoto originally hails from the Far East. Her parents died several years after her birth. Tsukuyomi and [Takemikazuchi](https://anilist.co/character/142543/Takemikazuchi) took the young girl into their orphanage, where she lived for years, eventually joining the Takemikazuchi Familia. Mikoto and the other members of the Takemikazuchi Familia used to sneak [Sanjouno Haruhime](https://anilist.co/character/142551/Sanjouno-Haruhime) out of her mansion at night to play with her. They were eventually caught, damaging relations between Haruhime's father and the shrine. They pursued their nightly fun regardless. Two years before the story, Mikoto and the other Takemikazuchi Familia members moved to Orario to earn money to help support the shrine.

Mikoto has a serious and honorable personality, unwilling to use cowardly tactics even in an emergency, as shown through her disapproval of Pass Parading the monsters that were chasing them onto the Hestia Familia. She also has a softer side as she cares for the well-being of her friends and is fiercely loyal to them.

__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 175 cm (5'9")

Welf Crozzo is a member of the Hestia Familia and Bell's personal blacksmith, later becoming one for the entire Hestia Familia after converting from the Hephaestus Familia. Welf was originally born in Rakia, a nation type Familia ruled by Ares. As a member of the Crozzo Family, he lived as a noble due to the successes his predecessors had in creating magic swords. However, his life changed the day his Skill Crozzo Blood appeared, which enabled him to create magic swords again. Despite his family's joy at the prospect of being able to create more magic swords, Welf despised his skill, causing him to escape Rakia with the help of his former Goddess Phobos. 

Welf Crozzo is a straightforward and honest person. He is generally casual to everyone that he associates with. He doesn't like to be associated with his family name, preferring to not be a part of the conversation when his name is brought up and even refuses people that come to him seeking magic swords.

__Race:__ Xenos 
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")
__Affiliation:__ Xenos • Hestia Familia • Ouranos
__Level:__ 2+ (estimate)

Wiene is a mysterious female Vouivre born in the middle floors of the Dungeon. It is later revealed that she is one of the Xenos. 

Wiene has the ability to speak even though she is a monster due to her being a Xenos. She is kind, helping a young boy even though people regarded monsters as evil. Wiene grew attached to the Hestia Familia, particularly Bell and Haruhime. Wiene doesn't like to wear clothes, as she refused to wear them and she even tried to get rid of the cape she was wearing due to the hot temperatures she was not used to before being convinced to keep it on. Originally, Wiene had more of a cowardly nature, influenced by all of the evil intent people had toward monsters, including the citizen's rejection of her even though she saved a boy. However, after she was reborn, she becomes much more courageous, reminding herself that Bell saved her even though people would scorn him for it.

__Race__: Half Elf
__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5")
__Affiliation:__ Guild

Eina Tulle is a receptionist at the Guild and Bell Cranel's advisor. Eina joined the Guild five years earlier at the age of 14 after she graduated from the school. Originally excited to work at the Guild, she quickly learned that it wasn't as fun as she thought it would be, eventually changing her personality into what it is now. She met Bell four years later and became his dungeon adviser. 

Eina shows a serious, calm demeanor, appearing as a very wise and sisterly figure towards Bell, even so far as getting worried whenever he went out to dangerous levels in the dungeon. She gets embarrassed when the subject of romance or love is mentioned, especially coming from Bell. Eina is passionate about her job as she doesn't want any adventurers under her care to die in the dungeon. She has a particular stance when it comes to advising adventurers; in addition to the usual Dungeon-prowling advice and regular meetings, she would also summon her adventurers to private lessons, where she crams as much Dungeon knowledge into their heads as possible. It was to the point where she gained a scary reputation among many adventurers, as she would often demand her pupils to perfectly draw out maps and monsters strategies from memory, with the threat of extra work if there were any mistakes. No one had lasted all the way to the end of her course, most ran away halfway through, and the only one known so far to be able to endure her lessons is Bell.

Due to her beauty, Eina is popular with her coworkers and adventurers and is often flirted on, and some keep on trying even if they're rejected like Dormul and Luvis. However, she is interested in men that are unreliable like Bell instead of reliable men.

Aisha Belka is a member of the Hermes Familia and a former executive member of the Ishtar Familia. Aisha is reliable and is known to adopt a sisterly attitude to those she decides to support. Her character is very respectable and is known for her courage, and she has a friendly relationship with [Haruhime](https://anilist.co/character/142551/Sanjouno-Haruhime). She is often very bold when interacting with [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) and when combined with her appearance makes him blush furiously. After saving Haruhime by destroying the first Killing Stone the Ishtar Familia acquired, [Ishtar](https://anilist.co/character/146789/Ishtar) charmed her, making her unable to disobey the Goddess even if the orders conflicted with Aisha's own personal convictions. Once Ishtar returned to Heaven, she returned to normal.

__Race:__ God
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")
__Affiliation:__ Hephaestus Familia

Hephaestus is the head of the Hephaestus Familia. Hephaestus shows a strict and hardworking nature compared to her friend, [Hestia](https://anilist.co/character/87654/Hestia), who was known as the lazy goddess. She is also known to care very much about her children.

As a Goddess of Smithing, Hephaestus is a master at it. She was able to smith the Hestia Knife, a living weapon with Hestia's falna, even without her arcanum.

Cassandra Ilion is a member of the Miach Familia and a former member of the Apollo Familia. Cassandra has a timid personality and is often seen with Daphne Lauros, who takes care of her. Like Daphne, she was pressured into joining the Apollo Familia. She also has the ability to see visions, and through this, she predicted that the Apollo Familia would be destroyed, though no one believed her until they lost the War Game against the Hestia Familia. Cassandra is shown to be grateful to Bell Cranel for believing her visions.

Anya Fromel is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility. When she was one year old, Anya lost her parents and her home. Because of this, her brother Allen was forced to wander the ruins of a kingdom while protecting her. So it was for two years until they met Freya, who offered them to go with her, which they accepted. Sometime before Ais came to Orario, Mia partially left the Freya Familia to open the Hostess of Fertility, employing Anya there.

Anya is shown to be a foolish person whose unthoughtful actions stand out. She is terrible at singing, enough to be referred to as a "disaster". Despite being somewhat of an airhead, she is loyal to her friends, such as when she was openly hostile to Hermes for mentioning Ryuu's past, and when she helped the Elf by being Chloe's opponent while she fought Lunoire. She used to act like a senior to Ryuu at work, though she failed miserably due to her unthoughtful actions, such as when she accidentally brought Lunoire coffee when she ordered tea. Even so, she refuses to give up, as shown when she repeatedly tried to touch Ryuu even though the Elf kept on swatting her away, at which point Ryuu thought she saw flames of resolve around her. However, she is reluctant to talk about her past, becoming startled when Ryuu asked her and immediately changed the subject. Anya is the younger sister of Allen Fromel. However, they have both cut ties with each other. Seemingly because of this, Anya refers to herself as an abandoned cat, and claims to not know who Vana Alfi is. Also, she was shown to lament something for a moment upon being called that and mentioned that it'd been a while since she last heard that name.

(Source: Danmachi Wiki)

Naaza Erisuis Is a doctor in the Miach Familia. Naaza has good relations with [Bell Cranel](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) just like [Miach](https://anilist.co/character/142549/Miach) and [Hestia](https://anilist.co/character/87654/Hestia). However, due to her Familia being poor, she sold Bell inferior items and talked him into buying high priced goods. Naaza still will help Bell when he needs it, such as when she helped him escape from [Hyakinthos Clio](https://anilist.co/character/143046/Clio-Hyakinthos). She also despises high class adventurers.

Naaza is also shown to have feelings for Miach ever since he sacrificed all of the Miach Familia's money to save her. She is normally indifferent, but can get fiercely jealous if it concerns Miach.

Daphne Lauros is a member of the Miach Familia and a former member of the Apollo Familia. Daphne is a calm and collected person despite her looks. She has mixed feelings for Apollo due to him taking care of her despite forcing her into his familia, stating that she was thankful, but hated him even more for that. She cares for Cassandra Ilion, although she doesn't believe her visions and dismisses them as dreams.

__Previous Affiliation:__ Altena
__Level:__ 4

Fels is a mysterious mage that is affiliated with Ouranos. Fels works directly under Ouranos and will take any orders from him, although they will act on their own if necessary. They consider their experience creating the stone that granted immortality as their trauma.

__Race:__ Xenos__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6")
__Affiliation:__ Xenos • Ouranos
__Level:__ 5 (estimate)

Lyd is a Lizardman Xenos. As a Xenos, Lyd is far more intelligent and powerful than a normal monster. He is one of the strongest Xenos, being on par with a first class adventurer. Lyd has red scales and orange eyes. He wears a full set of armor, wields a scimitar and a longsword.

Lyd is an openhearted and friendly individual, quickly warming up to Bell, who he met for the first time, even giving him a nickname. As one of the three leaders of the Xenos, Lyd cares deeply for his kind, and will go to great lengths to protect them. Like most of the Xenos, he has a strong desire to live on the surface with people. When he heard that Wiene was living with people, Lyd felt a glimmer of hope that things could change for the Xenos, and was extremely happy to meet said people in person. When he heard the fate of Ranye's group, as well as the capture of Wiene and Fear, Lyd's desire was one of the few things that prevented him from immediately succumbing to rage.

Ever since their first meeting, Lyd has highly treasured his friendship with Bell. He instructed Bell to not hesitate when it came to killing monsters, even if they were a Xenos, as he didn't want Bell to die. When Gros and the other Xenos desired revenge against the surface dwellers for the deaths of their brethren, Lyd tried to use Bell as an example that not all adventurers were bad. When Lyd saw Bell on the eighteenth floor, he got Bell away from the battle and told him to stay away, afraid that the boy would eventually betray him. When Bell declared that the Xenos were worthy of being saved during a battle against Dix Perdix, his words enabled Lyd to fight against the effects of Dix's curse and save Bell. While a plan was being made to return the Xenos that were stranded on the surface back to the Dungeon, Lyd expressed remorse for putting Bell and his familia through even more trouble. He agreed with Wiene that the Xenos would come to aid of the Hestia Familia whenever they needed it.

__Race:__ Human
__Height:__ 154 cm (5'1")
__Affiliation:__ Takemikazuchi Familia
__Level:__ 2

Chigusa Hitachi is a member of the Takemikazuchi Familia. Despite having a timid and shy personality, she is loyal to her Familia, especially [Ouka](https://anilist.co/character/143055/Ouka-Kashima) who she has feelings for.

__Race:__ Cat People
__Height:__ 158 cm (5'2")
__Affiliation:__ Hostess of Fertility • Njord Familia
__Level:__ 4
__Magic:__ Pheles Cruz
__Weapon:__ Violetta

Chloe Rollo is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility pub and a former assassin known as Rollo as a member of the Njord Familia. Chloe was born to parents who were members of a Familia that acted as a criminal organization. From the moment she was born, she was taught different methods of assassination, and was praised when she properly utilized them. However, she began to dislike her Familia after her mother died while protecting her. Her Goddess agreed to let her leave, though she was ordered to carry out a number of tasks before leaving, including assassinating a Level 3 knight of the empire using only a knife. Despite the extreme difficulty of her tasks, she was successful, leveling up in the process. After leaving her Familia, she traveled around for a while, until she came to Orario around nine years before the story. While there, she failed her first mission, which was to assassinate [Shakti Varma](https://anilist.co/character/209702/Varma-Shakti), barely escaping with her life, and began refusing jobs to kill first class adventurers. Eventually, after failing to kill a wanted [Ryuu](https://anilist.co/character/88890/Lion-Ryuu), she joined the Hostess of Fertility.

Chloe is known to have a crafty side and often gambles, which her fellow employees give a cold shoulder to. She is loyal to her fellow Hostess of Fertility coworkers, such as when she was openly hostile to [Hermes](https://anilist.co/character/142531/Hermes) for mentioning Ryuu's past. Despite being an assassin, she had a strict code of conduct, as she only killed people she considered to be scum and those who were resolved to die. She is a shotacon, as shown with her attitude toward [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell), and the fact that she labels young boys as "the treasure of the world". She first developed those feelings when she acted as a chivalrous thief for orphans while traveling on her own, and at the same time developed her greediness as well. Because of this, she refused to assassinate them if she was ever asked to. Also, she once considered having handsome young men serve her while she would caress their stomach and behind. As a part of her greediness, she stated that she would've tortured the fake Black Cat in order to make him pay up for impersonating her.

__Race:__ God
__Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") , 183 cm (6'0") with geta
__Affiliation:__ Takemikazuchi Familia

Takemikazuchi is a God and the head of the Takemikazuchi Familia. Takemikazuchi is friendly with [Hestia](https://anilist.co/character/87654/Hestia) and has taught her many things such as the dogeza. He is kind to his Familia members. He is also a natural gigolo, and is clueless to how his actions affect others around him, which makes him come out as insensitive.
