node.description: Alise Lovell was an adventurer and captain of the Astraea Familia.

__Race:__ God
__Height:__ 188 cm (6'2")
__Affiliation:__ Miach Familia

Miach is the head of the Miach Familia. Miach is a kind, compassionate, and friendly God, and has good relations with [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) and the members of the Hestia Familia, often handing out free potions to him. He has a habit of handing out free potions, causing financial problems for his Familia, and is referred to as a "natural gigolo" along with [Takemikazuchi](https://anilist.co/character/142543/Takemikazuchi) due to his friendliness toward women. He is also caring of his own Familia member [Naaza Erisuis](https://anilist.co/character/142546/Erisuis-Naaza), taking out a huge loan from the Dian Cecht Familia to have a silver arm created for her.

sampleCharacters.name: Haruhime Sanjouno
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Renard __Height:__ 156 cm (5'1") Sanjouno Haruhime is a member of the Hestia Familia and a former member of the Ishtar Familia. Haruhime grew up as a dignified young lady of a noble family in the Far East. Living in solitude, her home was like a cage and she had no friends. At some point, children of the Takemikazuchi Familia, with the approval of their God, started taking her outside at night to play with them. Sometime later, someone framed her for eating an offering, which angered her father so much that he disowned her and a Pallum guest offered to take her away. As they were traveling, they were attacked by monsters and the Pallum ran away, leaving Haruhime behind. She survived, but was later captured by bandits and sold to a brothel in Orario. While heading there, she caught the eye of [Ishtar](https://anilist.co/character/146789/Ishtar), who bought her. Haruhime became a member of the Ishtar Familia, where she was forced to work as a prostitute, until the Familia disbanded. Haruhime is a gentle, timid, well-mannered, and extremely kind girl. She is respectful of everyone she meets and is eager to help when given the chance. Having grown up mostly isolated and later kept hidden by the Ishtar Familia, Haruhime has experienced quite a sheltered life. And as such, even minor things will excite her. Haruhime developed a love of reading at a young age, as it was her way of escaping her loneliness. She has a fondness for fairy tales, particularly ones where the hero saves a damsel in distress. When she was made to work as a prostitute, she wished that a hero would come and save her like in those stories. As time went on, however, she convinced herself that she wouldn't be saved since she believed that her profession made her unworthy of rescue. However, Haruhime's view on this changed after [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) saved her regardless of her beliefs. Though she has never had to fend for herself, Haruhime displays an unusual sense of bravery when those she cares for are threatened. When [Wiene](https://anilist.co/character/146907/Wiene) was in danger, Haruhime leaped off a building in pursuit of her and stood up to [Bete](https://anilist.co/character/122632/Loga-Bete) in order to give Bell enough time to escort Wiene to safety. While working as a prostitute, Haruhime would foam at the mouth and collapse whenever she saw a naked man. Due to this, she is still a virgin, but is unaware of the fact.

sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Cat People __Height:__ 150 cm (4'11") __Affiliation:__ Hostess of Fertility __Level:__ 4 Anya Fromel is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility. When she was one year old, Anya lost her parents and her home. Because of this, her brother Allen was forced to wander the ruins of a kingdom while protecting her. So it was for two years until they met Freya, who offered them to go with her, which they accepted. Sometime before Ais came to Orario, Mia partially left the Freya Familia to open the Hostess of Fertility, employing Anya there. Anya is shown to be a foolish person whose unthoughtful actions stand out. She is terrible at singing, enough to be referred to as a "disaster". Despite being somewhat of an airhead, she is loyal to her friends, such as when she was openly hostile to Hermes for mentioning Ryuu's past, and when she helped the Elf by being Chloe's opponent while she fought Lunoire. She used to act like a senior to Ryuu at work, though she failed miserably due to her unthoughtful actions, such as when she accidentally brought Lunoire coffee when she ordered tea. Even so, she refuses to give up, as shown when she repeatedly tried to touch Ryuu even though the Elf kept on swatting her away, at which point Ryuu thought she saw flames of resolve around her. However, she is reluctant to talk about her past, becoming startled when Ryuu asked her and immediately changed the subject. Anya is the younger sister of Allen Fromel. However, they have both cut ties with each other. Seemingly because of this, Anya refers to herself as an abandoned cat, and claims to not know who Vana Alfi is. Also, she was shown to lament something for a moment upon being called that and mentioned that it'd been a while since she last heard that name. (Source: Danmachi Wiki)

sampleCharacters.name: Naaza Erisuis
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Chienthrope __Height:__ 169 cm (5'7") __Affiliation:__ Miach Familia __Level:__ 2 __Status:__ • Strength: G218 • Endurance: G204 • Dexterity: G293 • Agility: F339 • Magic: H187 • Mixing: I __Magic:__ Darbh Daol Naaza Erisuis Is a doctor in the Miach Familia. Naaza has good relations with [Bell Cranel](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) just like [Miach](https://anilist.co/character/142549/Miach) and [Hestia](https://anilist.co/character/87654/Hestia). However, due to her Familia being poor, she sold Bell inferior items and talked him into buying high priced goods. Naaza still will help Bell when he needs it, such as when she helped him escape from [Hyakinthos Clio](https://anilist.co/character/143046/Clio-Hyakinthos). She also despises high class adventurers. Naaza is also shown to have feelings for Miach ever since he sacrificed all of the Miach Familia's money to save her. She is normally indifferent, but can get fiercely jealous if it concerns Miach.

sampleCharacters.name: Daphne Lauros
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Human__Height:__ 164 cm (5'5") __Affiliation:__ Miach Familia (past), Apollo Familia (present) __Level:__ 3 __Achieved Floor:__ 27 __Status:__ • Strength: I0 • Endurance: I0 • Dexterity: I0 • Agility: I0 • Magic: I0 • Abnormal Resistance: I • Escape: ? __Skills:__ Elios Passion • Laurus Wreath __Magic:__ Raumure __Equipment:__ Fencer Laureate Daphne Lauros is a member of the Miach Familia and a former member of the Apollo Familia. Daphne is a calm and collected person despite her looks. She has mixed feelings for Apollo due to him taking care of her despite forcing her into his familia, stating that she was thankful, but hated him even more for that. She cares for Cassandra Ilion, although she doesn't believe her visions and dismisses them as dreams.

sampleCharacters.name: Fels
sampleCharacters.description: __Affiliation:__ Ouranos • Xenos __Previous Affiliation:__ Altena __Level:__ 4 __Status:__ • Mage: ? • Mystery: ? __Magic:__ Dia Panakeia • Dia Orpheus Fels is a mysterious mage that is affiliated with Ouranos. Fels works directly under Ouranos and will take any orders from him, although they will act on their own if necessary. They consider their experience creating the stone that granted immortality as their trauma.

sampleCharacters.name: Lyd
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Xenos__Height:__ 167 cm (5'6") __Affiliation:__ Xenos • Ouranos __Level:__ 5 (estimate) Lyd is a Lizardman Xenos. As a Xenos, Lyd is far more intelligent and powerful than a normal monster. He is one of the strongest Xenos, being on par with a first class adventurer. Lyd has red scales and orange eyes. He wears a full set of armor, wields a scimitar and a longsword. Lyd is an openhearted and friendly individual, quickly warming up to Bell, who he met for the first time, even giving him a nickname. As one of the three leaders of the Xenos, Lyd cares deeply for his kind, and will go to great lengths to protect them. Like most of the Xenos, he has a strong desire to live on the surface with people. When he heard that Wiene was living with people, Lyd felt a glimmer of hope that things could change for the Xenos, and was extremely happy to meet said people in person. When he heard the fate of Ranye's group, as well as the capture of Wiene and Fear, Lyd's desire was one of the few things that prevented him from immediately succumbing to rage. Ever since their first meeting, Lyd has highly treasured his friendship with Bell. He instructed Bell to not hesitate when it came to killing monsters, even if they were a Xenos, as he didn't want Bell to die. When Gros and the other Xenos desired revenge against the surface dwellers for the deaths of their brethren, Lyd tried to use Bell as an example that not all adventurers were bad. When Lyd saw Bell on the eighteenth floor, he got Bell away from the battle and told him to stay away, afraid that the boy would eventually betray him. When Bell declared that the Xenos were worthy of being saved during a battle against Dix Perdix, his words enabled Lyd to fight against the effects of Dix's curse and save Bell. While a plan was being made to return the Xenos that were stranded on the surface back to the Dungeon, Lyd expressed remorse for putting Bell and his familia through even more trouble. He agreed with Wiene that the Xenos would come to aid of the Hestia Familia whenever they needed it.

sampleCharacters.name: Chigusa Hitachi
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Human __Height:__ 154 cm (5'1") __Affiliation:__ Takemikazuchi Familia __Level:__ 2 Chigusa Hitachi is a member of the Takemikazuchi Familia. Despite having a timid and shy personality, she is loyal to her Familia, especially [Ouka](https://anilist.co/character/143055/Ouka-Kashima) who she has feelings for.

sampleCharacters.name: Chloe Rollo
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ Cat People __Height:__ 158 cm (5'2") __Affiliation:__ Hostess of Fertility • Njord Familia __Level:__ 4 __Magic:__ Pheles Cruz __Weapon:__ Violetta Chloe Rollo is a waitress at the Hostess of Fertility pub and a former assassin known as Rollo as a member of the Njord Familia. Chloe was born to parents who were members of a Familia that acted as a criminal organization. From the moment she was born, she was taught different methods of assassination, and was praised when she properly utilized them. However, she began to dislike her Familia after her mother died while protecting her. Her Goddess agreed to let her leave, though she was ordered to carry out a number of tasks before leaving, including assassinating a Level 3 knight of the empire using only a knife. Despite the extreme difficulty of her tasks, she was successful, leveling up in the process. After leaving her Familia, she traveled around for a while, until she came to Orario around nine years before the story. While there, she failed her first mission, which was to assassinate [Shakti Varma](https://anilist.co/character/209702/Varma-Shakti), barely escaping with her life, and began refusing jobs to kill first class adventurers. Eventually, after failing to kill a wanted [Ryuu](https://anilist.co/character/88890/Lion-Ryuu), she joined the Hostess of Fertility. Chloe is known to have a crafty side and often gambles, which her fellow employees give a cold shoulder to. She is loyal to her fellow Hostess of Fertility coworkers, such as when she was openly hostile to [Hermes](https://anilist.co/character/142531/Hermes) for mentioning Ryuu's past. Despite being an assassin, she had a strict code of conduct, as she only killed people she considered to be scum and those who were resolved to die. She is a shotacon, as shown with her attitude toward [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell), and the fact that she labels young boys as "the treasure of the world". She first developed those feelings when she acted as a chivalrous thief for orphans while traveling on her own, and at the same time developed her greediness as well. Because of this, she refused to assassinate them if she was ever asked to. Also, she once considered having handsome young men serve her while she would caress their stomach and behind. As a part of her greediness, she stated that she would've tortured the fake Black Cat in order to make him pay up for impersonating her.

sampleCharacters.name: Takemikazuchi
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 176 cm (5'9") , 183 cm (6'0") with geta __Affiliation:__ Takemikazuchi Familia Takemikazuchi is a God and the head of the Takemikazuchi Familia. Takemikazuchi is friendly with [Hestia](https://anilist.co/character/87654/Hestia) and has taught her many things such as the dogeza. He is kind to his Familia members. He is also a natural gigolo, and is clueless to how his actions affect others around him, which makes him come out as insensitive.

sampleCharacters.name: Miach
sampleCharacters.description: __Race:__ God __Height:__ 188 cm (6'2") __Affiliation:__ Miach Familia Miach is the head of the Miach Familia. Miach is a kind, compassionate, and friendly God, and has good relations with [Bell](https://anilist.co/character/88860/Cranel-Bell) and the members of the Hestia Familia, often handing out free potions to him. He has a habit of handing out free potions, causing financial problems for his Familia, and is referred to as a "natural gigolo" along with [Takemikazuchi](https://anilist.co/character/142543/Takemikazuchi) due to his friendliness toward women. He is also caring of his own Familia member [Naaza Erisuis](https://anilist.co/character/142546/Erisuis-Naaza), taking out a huge loan from the Dian Cecht Familia to have a silver arm created for her.

node.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm

Aki comes from a well off family and is known for her brutal treatment of men. As a result, she has gained the nickname "Cruel Princess" from her classmates. She allegedly rejected [Masamune-kun](https://anilist.co/character/81967/Makabe-Masamune) and gave him the nickname "Piggy" when the two were children leading to his transformation and commitment to revenge. 

~!It was later revealed though that her hatred towards men is because her childhood crush Masamune left without saying anything which left her heartbroken. When Masamune finally confronts her about the past she tells him that she never gave him the nickname "piggy" in the first place, and never heard of that nickname before. As Aki learns Masamune's identity and situation, she attempts to make him the same chubby boy he used to be. Aki mentions that she found his chubbiness "cute" and overall as a symbol of wealth implying that chubby guys are her type.!~

Yoshino is [Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki)'s maid and follower. She seems to be a clumsy girl. However, beneath her clumsy and shy appearance she is actually extremely deceptive and cold, able to deceive and hurt Aki without a second thought. Unlike Aki, Yoshino easily gained weight from sweets.

~!Later it was revealed that Yoshino had disguised herself as Aki eight years before, rejected Masamune, and gave him the nickname "Piggy" due to jealously towards Aki's affection to him, but soon realized that her actions caused Aki to become estrange towards men. She has been regretting this and attempted to repay what she has done after Aki and Masamune reunited in high school.!~

~!She later falls in love with Makabe Masamune.!~

__Height:__ 178 cm

A narcissistic boy who is obsessed with the idea of getting revenge. His feelings of revenge are aimed towards the popular rich girl, [Adagaki Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki). Despite his handsome appearance now, he was once a chubby kid who people liked to make fun of. 

~!It is shown later on that the reason he hates Adagaki Aki so much was because she rejected his feelings for her and nicknamed him "Piggy". Later on, in order to get revenge on Aki, Makabe teams up with [Koiwai Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/121008/Koiwai-Yoshino), Aki's maid.!~

**Height:** 159 cm

Neko Fujinomiya is a cute and cheerful rich girl who transferred school after [Masamune Makabe](https://anilist.co/character/81967/Makabe-Masamune) "gave her his coat on Christmas Eve" and fell in love with him. She has a frail body, needing to consume many drugs although she often makes jokes about it. Due to her habit of not wearing any panties, [Aki](https://anilist.co/character/76364/Adagaki-Aki) and [Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/121008/Koiwai-Yoshino) nicknamed her "Pantie-less Woman".

~!While claiming that she just needs Masamune to pretend that their first encounter were real, Neko is actually genuinely in love with Masamune when he's still chubby, although it is never revealed how. After Masamune rejected her, Neko's condition got worse and she underwent a surgery abroad, and then came back with better health and thus continue to support Masamune.!~

**Height:** 155 cm

Masamune's best friend who looks like a girl, but is actually a boy. ~!He has a small crush on Neko.!~

__Height:__ 138 cm
__Occupation:__ Housewife

She has light brown hair that curls at the tips and brown eyes. She wears a headband that has a dog footprint on and she usually is seen wearing an apron. She is very short, has a small body, and can be easily mistaken for a child, even though she is 42 years old. She is also the mother of Makabe Masamune.

Masamune's class rep. She loves Yaoi and likes pairing Masamune to Kojuurou.

~!She confessed her feelings to Masamune once, but got rejected.!~

She is the younger sister of [Masamune Makabe](https://anilist.co/character/81967/Makabe-Masamune) and currently attends middle school as a second year. She does not possess the same surname as her brother due to Masamune's choice of changing from Hayase to Makabe.

node.description:
Kaori is one the most caring personalities in the series. She is a classmate of [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/132848)'s back in their original world. She admires Hajime for his "strong" personalty and is the only classmate who pays attention to Hajime's existence in class even if she is popular in their school.

When summoned to another world, she receives the "Healer" job.

~!
Kaori was unable to notice her love for Hajime until he fell in the abyss which inspired her to become stronger in order to search for him. After reuniting with Hajime, she then joins their dungeon expeditions after confessing to him.!~

~! In volume 6, while Hajime is off fighting the first of the God's Apostles alone. Kaori becomes gravely injured back at the capital while fighting off one of her classmates. After Hajime wins the fight he learns of Kaori's weakened state and decides to transfer the soul of Kaori into the body of the apostle. In doing so Kaori becomes stronger all across the board and over time she learns to use the same abilities the apostle used against Hajime. !~

Yue is a vampire who was imprisoned in the abyss. She was betrayed by her uncle and peers because of her monstrous magic and regeneration that made her nearly immortal.

With a fateful encounter, Yue met [Hajime](https://anilist.co/character/132848/Nagumo-Hajime) in a sealed room in the abyss. After being rescued, Yue was the person who suppressed Hajime's madness before he became a monster and she soon became Hajime's "special" person after what transpired in the Abyss.

Her appearance was described to be like the highest grade bisque doll with blonde hair and crimson eyes. She is 323 years old despite her small physique because she is a Vampire Princess. Her name Yue isn't her real name and was only given by Hajime so that she could leave her dark past and move on.

~!Her real name is Aleytia.!~

__Height:__ 175 cm

Hajime was a complete otaku and always came to class with a sleepy expression. He was always bullied and was disliked by both of his male and female classmates for being close to their idol-like classmate [Kaori](https://anilist.co/character/132849). After wishing for his annoying classmates to be summoned to another world, the next thing he saw was they were on top of a pillar like structure in another world to become heroes.

He obtained the job of "Synergist" and continued to be bullied due to also being weak in this new world. He eventually fell into an abyss due to being hit by a classmate's fireball where he survived though a hell-like environment to become the powerful man he is today.

Hajime at the beginning of the story is said to have black hair and also has a slim body. He also had a kind face and attitude. But after falling in the abyss and eating a wolf-like monster, his body began to violently degenerate. When he drunk the sacred water, it made his body heal by destroying his bones and muscles then healing over and over again until he got a very muscular body due to overcompensation.

Due to the stress of breaking and healing, his hair turned white, a victim of the Marie Antoinette syndrome. His eyes also turned red and his body gained tattoo-like red lines which is the sign of him becoming a demonic monster similar to the monsters he ate that also possessed red lines along their bodies.

His personality was at first kind though he was considered incompetent. But after falling in the abyss, he became cruel and would kill any person who wants to cause him misfortune. He would also smile in front of danger which made [Shia](https://anilist.co/character/132850/Haulia-Shia) call him a new species of monster called "Predator." He may be cruel but he cares for his comrades.

Shia first appeared when Hajime and Yue were traveling in the Raisen Grand Canyon while being chased by a monster like a "shameless rabbit." She was in this situation because she foresaw Hajime would help her family. She soon became their traveling companion in the long run, having the attitude to get clingy to Hajime with energetic words and actions.

~!She came from a demi-human race tribe called Haulia, RabbitMan. She was described as having a body with beautiful curves, "melon" sized chest, grey hair having traces of blue pigments, blue eyes and of course bunny ears. She was discriminated by her own race because she was born different as a demi-human being able to use magic which resulted to Haulia tribe's banishment.

Shia wields a war hammer "Doryukken" made, named and enhanced by Hajime. Her age is 16 and has a job class of Diviner and also known for her Physical strengthening and "Foresight" ability.!~

Tio is a "pervert" with the main status of M but she is honest and the words this one speakeas are similar to the old legends. Her "M" personality was made into this because she was defeated by Hajime's party in the northern mountains of the village of Ul. She's loyal and devoted herself to Hajime to become his slave and calls him since then "Master."

~!
Tio originally came from the Ryujin tribe Clarce, half-dragon. Her magic and defense are significantly high especially in her Dragon form, even Hajime's party attacks only cracked the scales of this dragon. She is aged 563 years old and respected by Yue but not for so long. Her appearance is a woman of her 20's with "watermelon" chests and golden eyes. Her dragon form is a few meters long with golden eyes and has black dragon scales. Her job class is Guardian.!~

A young girl from the Sea-Dweller Tribe who got kidnapped to be sold as a slave, but was saved by Hajime Nagumo and Shea Haulia while they came across her in Fuhren. Initially,​ she had been calling Hajime as "Onii-chan", but later changed to call him "Papa".

Kaori's best friend. She's the childhood friend of Kouki and her family runs a dojo.

Shizuku is a hardworking, kind and caring girl who passes her time on practicing her swordsmanship. She is regarded as a cool and stoic beauty, but actually has a girlish side that likes cute things, such as the color pink, as well as cute animals like cats and bunnies. She has often hid her true feelings and would put up a brave face, as a front so other people did not worry about her.
She is Myu's mother.

She is the Homeroom Teacher who along with her students from Japan got involved in the Summoning Incident, and ended up in Tortus. She is a responsible teacher and cares for her students a lot.

(Source: Wikia)

A mysterious woman with silver hair and blue eyes. 
She is characterized by inorganic and expressionless.
It is unclear what kind of existence it is.

It is shown in the Trailer, that she will fight against Hajime.

~!She was an apostle who disguised herself as a nun, that was sent by Ehit to remove any unnecessary pieces from his "game board".!~

She is one of the students from Japan who got involved in the Summoning Incident, and ended up in Tortus along with her other classmates. She is friends with Taeko Sugawara & Nana Miyazaki, and was a part of Aiko's bodyguards protecting her from danger of any kind including the honey-traps of the kingdom.
An atavist and one of the leaders of the Liberators prior to them being wiped out.

One of the students from Japan who got involved in the Summoning Incident. She was part of Kouki Amanogawa's party during the training in Great Orcus Labyrinth and is also Ryuutarou Sakagami's girlfriend.

He is the chieftain of the Haulia tribe and is gentle at first. But after they were trained by Hajime he became cruel and one of the best assassins in their tribe even defeating a group of 50 Bear-man tribe.

Eri is one of the summoned heroes. She is always seen looking shy and delicate. 

~!In the beginning, Eri is portrayed as a calm and quiet girl that loves books. Later on, however, it is shown that she is very cunning and willing to take advantage of classmates for her own personal gain. She has a very deep and deranged obsession for Kouki to the point that she is willing to kill him in order to use 'soul bind' on him and make him her puppet and "boyfriend" forever.!~

He is one of the students from Japan who got involved in the summoning incident, and ended up in Tortus along with his other classmates. He is somewhat like the leader of the whole class, as most of the students look up to him. This is further enforced by him being bestowed with the rare job as the Hero.

~!In the After Story, Kouki becomes filled with immense guilt over his past behavior and actions which prompts him to drop out of high school and wander around Tortus, immediately taking on bounty jobs to kill monsters as an act of atonement to the point of recklessness.!~

One of the students from Japan who got involved in the Summoning Incident, and ended up in Tortus along with his other classmates. He is the childhood friend of [Kouki Amanogawa](https://anilist.co/character/218390/Kouki-Amanogawa), [Shizuku Yaegashi](https://anilist.co/character/141266/Shizuku-Yaegashi) and [Kaori Shirasaki](https://anilist.co/character/132849/Kaori-Shirasaki); and was part of Kouki's party during the training in Great Orcus Labyrinth. He is also the boyfriend of Suzu Taniguchi.

(Source: Arifureta Wiki)

After Hajime wins the fight he learns of Kaori's weakened state and decides to transfer the soul of Kaori into the body of the apostle. In doing so Kaori becomes stronger all across the board and over time she learns to use the same abilities the apostle used against Hajime. !~

sampleCharacters.name: Shia Haulia
sampleCharacters.description: Shia first appeared when Hajime and Yue were traveling in the Raisen Grand Canyon while being chased by a monster like a "shameless rabbit." She was in this situation because she foresaw Hajime would help her family. She soon became their traveling companion in the long run, having the attitude to get clingy to Hajime with energetic words and actions. ~!She came from a demi-human race tribe called Haulia, RabbitMan. She was described as having a body with beautiful curves, "melon" sized chest, grey hair having traces of blue pigments, blue eyes and of course bunny ears. She was discriminated by her own race because she was born different as a demi-human being able to use magic which resulted to Haulia tribe's banishment. Shia wields a war hammer "Doryukken" made, named and enhanced by Hajime. Her age is 16 and has a job class of Diviner and also known for her Physical strengthening and "Foresight" ability.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Tio Klarus
sampleCharacters.description: Tio is a "pervert" with the main status of M but she is honest and the words this one speakeas are similar to the old legends. Her "M" personality was made into this because she was defeated by Hajime's party in the northern mountains of the village of Ul. She's loyal and devoted herself to Hajime to become his slave and calls him since then "Master." ~! Tio originally came from the Ryujin tribe Clarce, half-dragon. Her magic and defense are significantly high especially in her Dragon form, even Hajime's party attacks only cracked the scales of this dragon. She is aged 563 years old and respected by Yue but not for so long. Her appearance is a woman of her 20's with "watermelon" chests and golden eyes. Her dragon form is a few meters long with golden eyes and has black dragon scales. Her job class is Guardian.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Myuu
sampleCharacters.description: A young girl from the Sea-Dweller Tribe who got kidnapped to be sold as a slave, but was saved by Hajime Nagumo and Shea Haulia while they came across her in Fuhren. Initially,​ she had been calling Hajime as "Onii-chan", but later changed to call him "Papa".

sampleCharacters.name: Shizuku Yaegashi
sampleCharacters.description: Kaori's best friend. She's the childhood friend of Kouki and her family runs a dojo. Shizuku is a hardworking, kind and caring girl who passes her time on practicing her swordsmanship. She is regarded as a cool and stoic beauty, but actually has a girlish side that likes cute things, such as the color pink, as well as cute animals like cats and bunnies. She has often hid her true feelings and would put up a brave face, as a front so other people did not worry about her.

sampleCharacters.name: Aiko Hatayama
sampleCharacters.description: She is the Homeroom Teacher who along with her students from Japan got involved in the Summoning Incident, and ended up in Tortus. She is a responsible teacher and cares for her students a lot. (Source: Wikia)

sampleCharacters.name: Yuuka Sonobe
sampleCharacters.description: She is one of the students from Japan who got involved in the Summoning Incident, and ended up in Tortus along with her other classmates. She is friends with Taeko Sugawara & Nana Miyazaki, and was a part of Aiko's bodyguards protecting her from danger of any kind including the honey-traps of the kingdom.

sampleCharacters.name: Miledi Reisen
sampleCharacters.description: An atavist and one of the leaders of the Liberators prior to them being wiped out.

sampleCharacters.name: Suzu Taniguchi
sampleCharacters.description: One of the students from Japan who got involved in the Summoning Incident. She was part of Kouki Amanogawa's party during the training in Great Orcus Labyrinth and is also Ryuutarou Sakagami's girlfriend.

sampleCharacters.name: Cam Haulia
sampleCharacters.description: He is the chieftain of the Haulia tribe and is gentle at first. But after they were trained by Hajime he became cruel and one of the best assassins in their tribe even defeating a group of 50 Bear-man tribe.

sampleCharacters.name: Eri Nakamura
sampleCharacters.description: Eri is one of the summoned heroes. She is always seen looking shy and delicate. ~!In the beginning, Eri is portrayed as a calm and quiet girl that loves books. Later on, however, it is shown that she is very cunning and willing to take advantage of classmates for her own personal gain. She has a very deep and deranged obsession for Kouki to the point that she is willing to kill him in order to use 'soul bind' on him and make him her puppet and "boyfriend" forever.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Kouki Amanogawa
sampleCharacters.description: He is one of the students from Japan who got involved in the summoning incident, and ended up in Tortus along with his other classmates. He is somewhat like the leader of the whole class, as most of the students look up to him. This is further enforced by him being bestowed with the rare job as the Hero. ~!In the After Story, Kouki becomes filled with immense guilt over his past behavior and actions which prompts him to drop out of high school and wander around Tortus, immediately taking on bounty jobs to kill monsters as an act of atonement to the point of recklessness.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Ryuutarou Sakagami
sampleCharacters.description: One of the students from Japan who got involved in the Summoning Incident, and ended up in Tortus along with his other classmates. He is the childhood friend of [Kouki Amanogawa](https://anilist.co/character/218390/Kouki-Amanogawa), [Shizuku Yaegashi](https://anilist.co/character/141266/Shizuku-Yaegashi) and [Kaori Shirasaki](https://anilist.co/character/132849/Kaori-Shirasaki); and was part of Kouki's party during the training in Great Orcus Labyrinth. He is also the boyfriend of Suzu Taniguchi. (Source: Arifureta Wiki)

title.native: 終末のワルキューレⅡ

node.description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

__Species:__ God, Human (formerly)
~!__Affiliation:__ Humanity!~

Buddha has an easygoing attitude and does not seem to take anything seriously. His confidence is great enough for him to challenge [Zeus](https://anilist.co/character/140640/Zeus) to his face by claiming that the only one who can push him around in "all of heaven and Earth" is himself. Buddha also appears to have a sweet tooth as he was seen eating lollipops when walking and eating chocolates while relaxing.

Buddha also seems to display respect for other people by offering them foods he's currently eating, like when he didn't allow Zeus to steal one of his sweets, but offered his popcorn to [Brunhilde](https://anilist.co/character/140636/Brunhilde).

~!The human's representative for round 6!~

name.native: ジャック・ザ・リッパー

node.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Humanity 

Jack the Ripper, or Jack, is an infamous serial killer hailing from late 19th century Britain.

Normally, Jack has the disposition of a typical British Gentlemen, accentuated by his sophisticated diction and actions. However, Jack is a true sadist and monster at heart, being considered by most to be a person shrouded in malice and evil, murdering people as he considers the fear they feel before death to be absolutely beautiful. ~!Jack the Ripper is Humanity's representative in the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~

__Species__: Demigod

Brunhilde is the eldest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the main protagonist of the series.

She is the one who chose humanity's finest and strongest warriors in Ragnarok to stand up against the strongest gods in combat and slay them in an attempt to save Humanity.
Kojiro Sasaki's a famous swordsman from Japan, known as "History's Greatest Loser". ~!Kojiro Sasaki is Humanity's representative in the third round of Ragnarok.!~
The God of destruction and one of the principal deities of Hinduism.

Heracles is a prominent deity in the Greek Pantheon. He is also one of the few divine beings, along with [Buddha](https://anilist.co/character/175945/Buddha) and the Valkyries, who are not in favor of ending Humanity.

~!Heracles is the Gods' representative in the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~
Messenger of the gods.

The Gods' representative in the eleventh round of Ragnarok.
He is a prominent deity in the Norse Pantheon, known as the God of Mischief.

__Species:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Humanity

Raiden Tameemon, born Tarōkochi Seki, is Humanity's representative in the fifth round of Ragnarok.

Göll described Raiden as the "incarnation of desire", being shown as a perverted and lustful man when around beautiful women. Despite this, he claims that he's always completely serious about any statement he makes.

Growing up as child, Raiden was viewed a monster by many other kids and became depressed, his mother would encourage him to use his strength for the good of the weak and always hugged him with love. From that day, Raiden took his mother's words to heart and used his strength to help the villagers around him. When the "Great Tenmei Famine" began, Raiden became saddened by the death and suffering occuring all over his village and so decided to become a sumo wrestler to raise money for his hometown.

It is said that Raiden has the strongest muscles in human history and was considered to be the best of all time.

__Species:__ Demigod

Göll is the youngest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the deuteragonist of the series. During the Ragnarok matches, she is usually seen with Brunhilde anxiously watching each match.

She's usually anxious and worried about many things to the point that it gets on Brunhilde's and Hrist's nerves. Whenever humanity's warriors die, she cries and mourns each of her sisters as they die with them.
As an apprentice valkyrie, she doesn't seem all that interested in saving humanity compared to worrying about her sisters.
Captain of the first unit of the Shinsengumi. ~!Souji Okita is Humanity's representative in the tenth round of Ragnarok.!~
Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of beauty.

__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Zeus is a prominent deity and the Supreme God in the Greek Pantheon. He is also the chairman of the Gods' Council and often referred to as the "God Father of Cosmos"

When addressing his fellow gods, Zeus is extremely calm and authoritative while possessing a very formal and wise disposition. Like most gods, Zeus holds his own kind to a superior and extremely high standard, always expecting them to win no matter the odds, and seething with anger when they lose to humans. Zeus is also an eccentric individual, having random exaggerated emotional outbursts, breaking into a dance at the start of the second round of Ragnarok in front of everyone present, even being called the most shameful god by Hermes.

However, after several rounds of Ragnarok passed, Zeus became more humble, even acknowledging Humanity's strength. He is also extremely faithful and confident in those of the Greek Pantheon.

~!Zeus is the Gods' representative in the second round of Ragnarok.!~
Supreme god of Nordic.

__Species:__ Demigod

Hlökk is the eleventh of the 13 Valkyrie sisters. ~!She forms a Völundr with [Jack the Ripper](https://anilist.co/character/159840/Jack-the-Ripper) during the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~
Prudr is the third of the Valkyrie sisters.~!She forms a Völundr with [Raiden Tameemon](https://anilist.co/character/168999/Raiden-Tameemon) during Ragnarok.!~
The watchman of the apocalypse.
Rudra is the Hindu god of storms and the dear friend of Shiva, who is participating in the fifth round of Ragnarök.
Ares is the 6th of the 12 Gods of Olympus and the Greek God of War.

Parvati is the Hindu goddess of fertility, love, and beauty. She is Shiva's first* wife.

~!* In the native Japanese manga she is marked as Shiva's first wife, but in translations she is marked as his second. Reason being that according to Hindu Lore, Parvati's previous past life was Sati, who was Shiva's first wife or lover. However, she immolated herself due to her father Daksha's disapproval of their marriage. Shiva would then wait for Sati to reincarnate as Parvati, who would officially became his second wife.!~
Kali is the Hindu goddess of death, time, and the end of the world.She is Shiva's second wife, who is participating in the fifth round of Ragnarök.
Muninn is one of the pair of ravens that accompany Odin.
A Japanese swordsman and official of the late Edo period.

node.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")

The fifteen-year-old protagonist of the story, Rin is the son of [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449) born from a human woman and is the inheritor of Satan's powers. His powers were sealed at birth into the demon-slaying blade Kurikara, or Koumaken, by [Mephisto Pheles](https://anilist.co/character/30432), allowing him to live a normal human life for about 15 years.

Shura Kirigakure is a Knight and an Upper-First Class Exorcist. Having trained under the guidance of Shirou Fujimoto, she officially works as an inspector for the Vatican, but has infiltrated True Cross Academy, first as a student under the name Yamada, and later as a teacher for the Exwires. She is currently the mentor of Rin Okumura.

name.native: メフィスト・フェレス

node.description:
__Height:__ 195 cm (6'5") 

Pheles is the Chairman of True Cross Academy and also an Exorcist. After Fujimoto's death Pheles was ordered to kill Rin, however he accepted Rin's proposal in becoming an Exorcist and entered him into True Cross Academy. It has been heavily implied that he is the son of Satan along with his brother, the Earth King, Amaimon. He possesses the unique and peculiar ability of transforming into a small dog after counting down from three in German. How powerful he is has not been shown but he has mentioned that he is an honorary knight, the position two ranks below Paladin. He has been shown responsible for allowing several higher class demons onto campus. His name is an obvious pun on the word Mephistopheles, which is name for the another infamous devil, similar to his father Satan.

A two-tailed cat demon (nekomata).  Formerly Fujimoto's familiar but is now Rin's familiar.  Kuro is a Cat Sith who was once worshipped as a protective deity for silkworms.  He usually takes the appearance of a kitten, but he can reach an enormous size at will.

__Height:__ 180 cm (5'11") 

Yukio is Rin Okumura's twin and younger brother and Shiro Fujimoto's adopted son. He is a Middle First Class Exorcist who has started his training to become an Exorcist at seven by his father suggestion and, since then, gained the titles of Dragoon and Doctor at only fourteen, becoming the youngest Exorcist in the True Cross Order history. Yukio is also the youngest teacher of the True Cross' Exorcist Cram School, at which he teaches pharmacology. Before he was born, he has had a weak body that couldn't bear the power of the blue flames, causing the power of Satan to be fully inherited by Rin. He is seen as an ​example and prodigy by the ones who live together with him and is friends with Shiemi Moriyama, who calls him Yuki-chan.

__Height:__ 177 cm (5'8")

Shirou Fujimoto was [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin) and [Yukio](https://anilist.co/character/24734/Okumura-Yukio)'s guardian and was also considered to be one of the most powerful Exorcists in the world. He was thought to be the only man in the world that was able to sustain possession by [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449/Satan) himself and thus Satan was constantly after his body. Fujimoto had a familiar sith cat demon, which he called [Kuro](https://anilist.co/character/43187/Kuro), that Rin had inherited. He was a confirmed Aria, Dragoon and tamer and could possibly have been a Knight and a Docter as two of those who have studied under him have become these. He was said to be the strongest exorcist on the planet and was the only one to gain the rank of Paladin, the highest rank of the exorcists.

__Height:__ 165 cm (5'4")    

Slightly allergic to pollen. Shiemi is [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin)'s classmate and friend. Before she met Rin, Shiemi tended her grandmother's garden while her mother ran an Exorcist only shop inside True Cross Academy. During her encounter with Rin and [Yukio](https://anilist.co/character/24734/Okumura-Yukio), they were able to discover that Shiemi was having her life force leached out by a Demon. After Yukio exorcised the demon, Shiemi finally decided to become an Exorcist and started to attend class. It was later revealed that Shiemi had talent in becoming a Tamer, as she was able to summon a Greenman Spirit during class. It is apparently a rare talent to possess amongst the Exorcists, where there are only a few who can control demons and fight.

__Height:__ 164 cm

Izumo Kamiki is a top student at the Exorcism Cram School of True Cross Academy who comes from a long line of shrine maidens.

__Height:__ 181 cm

He is [Rin's](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin) rival and the prodigy in the class. He was the child of the Cursed Temple which was destroyed by [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449/Satan) 16 years ago. Bon takes everything seriously and is trying his hardest in order to become an Exorcist powerful enough so he could one day defeat Satan ( a goal he claims Rin stole from him) and rebuild his Temple. Currently Bon is trying to acquire the title of Meister in both Aria (a person who recites holy texts to kill certain demons) and Dragoon (a person who fights with heavy artillery). He is currently an Exwire. He is good at memorization, cleaning and Zen meditation.

__Height:__ 176 cm

Renzou is a very carefree character, yet he has a fear of many things, mainly bugs. He's very loyal to Bon, his childhood friend. They grew up together along with Konekomaru in Kyoto. He is also has a big obsession with women. Plans to become a Meister in Aria He is the 5th and youngest son of his family, and tells Konekomaru he's glad of this because it means he has less responsibilities. His older brother Juuzou says he's the pervert out of the brothers. Renzou is a carefree character and was the first person to actually befriend Rin since the revealing of the blue flames, which shows Renzou is the friendly-type. He is also afraid of bugs, yet he is known as the pervert out of the Shima brothers.

Nii-chan is Shiemi Moriyama's Familiar that she summons during the demonstration after Izumo Kamiki summoned two spirit foxes. It is a baby Greenman spirit that takes a liking to Shiemi often sitting on top of her head. Nii-chan aids Shiemi by producing plant from it's body such as aloe and sprouts tree branches as barriers. Nii-chan appears protective of Shiemi as he shields her from the falling debris during a mission in the amusement park with tree barriers. Possibly because it's still an infant, it does not think of Shiemi or the humans as a threat. It speaks by saying the phrase "Nii!"

__Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") 

He is an Arc Knight and an Exorcist of the True Cross Order.

~!He is the traveling companion and right-hand man of Arthur A. Angel, which makes him ranked second in the True Cross Order.!~

~!He reveals that he doesn't experience empathy towards people, and has always lacked this ability since he was born!~

__Height:__ 155 cm

Konekomaru Miwa hails from Kyoto along with Ryuji Suguro and Renzo Shima and is an Exwire of the True Cross Order, a student of the Exorcist Cram School, and the surviving head of the Miwa family.

__Height:__ 163 cm

Takara is a quiet, mysterious character. He is also somewhat of a ventriloquist. He hasn't talked much, and when he does, it's usually through ventriloquism. He is short, only slightly taller than Konekomaru, and wears the typical True Cross Academy uniform. Has yet to be shown opening his eyes and is always seen with his rabbit puppet. Not much is known about him he also did not contribute to the group effort in the Exwire exam. However, when he speaks with his rabbit puppet, the voice and tone is usually very rude.

name.native: アーサー・オーギュスト・エンジェル

node.description:
The newly appointed Paladin. He was ordered by the Grigori to to interrogate Mephisto and captured Rin as evidence. According to Shura he's a saint on the outside and a devil inside. Uses the demon sword Caliburn.

Not much is known about Arthur so far, except that he is extremely loyal to the True Cross Order. He follows the orders of his superiors without questioning them at all, even attempting to kill people when they interfere with his work. He believes that anything related to Satan must be destroyed, as it could only cause harm to let them live. Arthur also seems to be slightly sadistic, as he stabbed Rin completely through the leg to immobilize him during Rin's trial, while remarking that the wound would heal soon enough. According to Shura, he is a saint on the outside and a devil on the inside, hinting that he may have a malicious personality.

Kinzou is the fourth son of the Shima family, Renzou's older brother. He seems to be a pretty simple guy who is ruled by his emotions, kicking his little brother in the head as a greeting and paying no attention to the conversation at breakfast, preferring to stuff his face.
Ryuuji Suguro's father. Survivor of the Blue Night, when scores of clergymen were massacred by Satan. Known as the "Priest of the Cursed Temple."  (source: BlueExorcist.com)

Juuzou is the 2nd son of the Shima family, his younger brothers include Kinzou and Renzou. As the 2nd son, he has more responsibilities than his younger brothers. Since the 1st son of the Shima family was killed in the Blue Night incident 16 years ago, Juuzou is the successor of the Shima family. He and Houjou Mamushi are childhood friends and attended the Exorcist cramschool together.

The King of Light and the strongest of the Eight Demon Kings. He is also the Commander-in-Chief of the Illuminati.

(Source: Ao no Exorcist Wiki)
Noriko is Izumo's best friend but quits the cram school because she did not understand the classes and she was failing.
She is an Exorcist at the Kyoto Branch of the True Cross Order and Uwabami Houjou's daughter. Her sisters are Mamushi and Ao Houjou.
Miketsu, or simply Mike, is a Byakko and Eighth in rank amongst his peers. He is Izumo Kamiki's familiar, having previously served her mother, Tamamo Kamiki.
is an Upper First Class Exorcist, and the Chief of the True Cross Order's Kyoto Branch Office. He is the father of Juuzou, Kinzou and Renzou Shima, as well as the overall head of the Shima family.

Upper second-class exorcist of the Order, First Year Magic Circles and Seals instructor at the True Cross Academy, and Warden of the Deep Keep.
~! He has betrayed the Order as he helped steal the Left Eye of the Impure King, which used to be in the Deep Keep.!~ ~! He is a Demon Eater and has swallowed Karura the Phoenix, which has given him impressive regeneration skills. Now, he answers to the Illuminati secret society.!~
A high-ranking member of the Illuminati and captain of Phosphorus, Lucifer's bodyguards. Also the daughter of Saburota Todo.

sampleCharacters.name: Ryuuji Suguro
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 181 cm He is [Rin's](https://anilist.co/character/24482/Okumura-Rin) rival and the prodigy in the class. He was the child of the Cursed Temple which was destroyed by [Satan](https://anilist.co/character/48449/Satan) 16 years ago. Bon takes everything seriously and is trying his hardest in order to become an Exorcist powerful enough so he could one day defeat Satan ( a goal he claims Rin stole from him) and rebuild his Temple. Currently Bon is trying to acquire the title of Meister in both Aria (a person who recites holy texts to kill certain demons) and Dragoon (a person who fights with heavy artillery). He is currently an Exwire. He is good at memorization, cleaning and Zen meditation.

sampleCharacters.name: Renzou Shima
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 176 cm Renzou is a very carefree character, yet he has a fear of many things, mainly bugs. He's very loyal to Bon, his childhood friend. They grew up together along with Konekomaru in Kyoto. He is also has a big obsession with women. Plans to become a Meister in Aria He is the 5th and youngest son of his family, and tells Konekomaru he's glad of this because it means he has less responsibilities. His older brother Juuzou says he's the pervert out of the brothers. Renzou is a carefree character and was the first person to actually befriend Rin since the revealing of the blue flames, which shows Renzou is the friendly-type. He is also afraid of bugs, yet he is known as the pervert out of the Shima brothers.

sampleCharacters.name: Nii-chan
sampleCharacters.description: Nii-chan is Shiemi Moriyama's Familiar that she summons during the demonstration after Izumo Kamiki summoned two spirit foxes. It is a baby Greenman spirit that takes a liking to Shiemi often sitting on top of her head. Nii-chan aids Shiemi by producing plant from it's body such as aloe and sprouts tree branches as barriers. Nii-chan appears protective of Shiemi as he shields her from the falling debris during a mission in the amusement park with tree barriers. Possibly because it's still an infant, it does not think of Shiemi or the humans as a threat. It speaks by saying the phrase "Nii!"

sampleCharacters.name: Lewin Light
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 177 cm (5'10") He is an Arc Knight and an Exorcist of the True Cross Order. ~!He is the traveling companion and right-hand man of Arthur A. Angel, which makes him ranked second in the True Cross Order.!~ ~!He reveals that he doesn't experience empathy towards people, and has always lacked this ability since he was born!~

sampleCharacters.name: Konekomaru Miwa
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 155 cm Konekomaru Miwa hails from Kyoto along with Ryuji Suguro and Renzo Shima and is an Exwire of the True Cross Order, a student of the Exorcist Cram School, and the surviving head of the Miwa family.

sampleCharacters.name: Nemu Takara
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 163 cm Takara is a quiet, mysterious character. He is also somewhat of a ventriloquist. He hasn't talked much, and when he does, it's usually through ventriloquism. He is short, only slightly taller than Konekomaru, and wears the typical True Cross Academy uniform. Has yet to be shown opening his eyes and is always seen with his rabbit puppet. Not much is known about him he also did not contribute to the group effort in the Exwire exam. However, when he speaks with his rabbit puppet, the voice and tone is usually very rude.

sampleCharacters.name: Arthur Auguste Angel
sampleCharacters.description: The newly appointed Paladin. He was ordered by the Grigori to to interrogate Mephisto and captured Rin as evidence. According to Shura he's a saint on the outside and a devil inside. Uses the demon sword Caliburn. Not much is known about Arthur so far, except that he is extremely loyal to the True Cross Order. He follows the orders of his superiors without questioning them at all, even attempting to kill people when they interfere with his work. He believes that anything related to Satan must be destroyed, as it could only cause harm to let them live. Arthur also seems to be slightly sadistic, as he stabbed Rin completely through the leg to immobilize him during Rin's trial, while remarking that the wound would heal soon enough. According to Shura, he is a saint on the outside and a devil on the inside, hinting that he may have a malicious personality.

sampleCharacters.name: Kinzou Shima
sampleCharacters.description: Kinzou is the fourth son of the Shima family, Renzou's older brother. He seems to be a pretty simple guy who is ruled by his emotions, kicking his little brother in the head as a greeting and paying no attention to the conversation at breakfast, preferring to stuff his face.

sampleCharacters.name: Tatsuma Suguro
sampleCharacters.description: Ryuuji Suguro's father. Survivor of the Blue Night, when scores of clergymen were massacred by Satan. Known as the "Priest of the Cursed Temple." (source: BlueExorcist.com)

sampleCharacters.name: Juuzou Shima
sampleCharacters.description: Juuzou is the 2nd son of the Shima family, his younger brothers include Kinzou and Renzou. As the 2nd son, he has more responsibilities than his younger brothers. Since the 1st son of the Shima family was killed in the Blue Night incident 16 years ago, Juuzou is the successor of the Shima family. He and Houjou Mamushi are childhood friends and attended the Exorcist cramschool together.

sampleCharacters.name: Lucifer
sampleCharacters.description: The King of Light and the strongest of the Eight Demon Kings. He is also the Commander-in-Chief of the Illuminati. (Source: Ao no Exorcist Wiki)

sampleCharacters.name: Noriko Paku
sampleCharacters.description: Noriko is Izumo's best friend but quits the cram school because she did not understand the classes and she was failing.

sampleCharacters.name: Nishiki Houjou
sampleCharacters.description: She is an Exorcist at the Kyoto Branch of the True Cross Order and Uwabami Houjou's daughter. Her sisters are Mamushi and Ao Houjou.

sampleCharacters.name: Miketsu
sampleCharacters.description: Miketsu, or simply Mike, is a Byakko and Eighth in rank amongst his peers. He is Izumo Kamiki's familiar, having previously served her mother, Tamamo Kamiki.

sampleCharacters.name: Yaozou Shima
sampleCharacters.description: is an Upper First Class Exorcist, and the Chief of the True Cross Order's Kyoto Branch Office. He is the father of Juuzou, Kinzou and Renzou Shima, as well as the overall head of the Shima family.

sampleCharacters.name: Saburouta Toudou
sampleCharacters.description: Upper second-class exorcist of the Order, First Year Magic Circles and Seals instructor at the True Cross Academy, and Warden of the Deep Keep. ~! He has betrayed the Order as he helped steal the Left Eye of the Impure King, which used to be in the Deep Keep.!~ ~! He is a Demon Eater and has swallowed Karura the Phoenix, which has given him impressive regeneration skills. Now, he answers to the Illuminati secret society.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Homare Todo
sampleCharacters.description: A high-ranking member of the Illuminati and captain of Phosphorus, Lucifer's bodyguards. Also the daughter of Saburota Todo.

node.description: A Princess of Belfast, and daughter of King Tristwin and Queen Yuel. Yumina met Touya when he heals her father from an attempted poisoning. Yumina possess the Null magic "Mystic Eyes", an ability that comes from her Heterochromic Eyes which give her the ability to see a person's true nature. Due to this power, upon seeing the selfless and kind aura surrounding Touya after he saves her father, she asks to be engaged to him, believing that she will never find a better candidate to be her husband. She is also proficient with bows and arrows, often choosing to fight alongside a pack of hunting wolves summoned with her darkness attribute.

Born in the far eastern country of Eashen to a samurai family, Yae left her home to travel and hone her skills elsewhere. Touya's group crosses paths with her during their travels, helping to fend off a group of ruffians attacking her. Thereafter, she decides to accompany Touya on his travels.

Touya is a young boy who has come to this other world. For the most part, he is very well-mannered, but when he feels that those close to him could be harmed, he also has a side that will not hesitate.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

Elze is an adventurer equipped with gauntlets on both hands. She is the type who acts rather than talks and often pitches in before thinking. She is the older of the twins.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

Linze was in the city with her sister and right before they were tricked into something, Touya saved them. She is reserved, but there are times where she shows her inner strength. She is the younger of the twins.

(Source: Honey's Anime)

As head of the Fairy Tribe of Mismede, Leen serves as the court mage of the Kingdom of Mismede and is capable of using her personal null magic, 'Program'. Over the span of 200 years, she has used 'Program' to create an automated teddy bear named Paula who can to interact with humans, though it has yet to gain the capability to speak.
Kohaku, formerly known as The White Tiger, is a companion and contracted beast of Touya on his journey. She is one of the Four Heavenly Beasts and also the leader of the Magical Beasts.

Sakura is one of Touya Mochizuki's wives. She survived from an assassination attempt after being rescued by Touya. However, she suffered amnesia was given the temporary name Sakura by Touya. Later, it is revealed that her real name is Farnese Forneus but she decides to use Sakura as her name. She is actually planned as the successor of Xenoahs Demon Kingdom. Currently, she stays with Touya at Brunhild Dukedom.
Cecile is a maid from the Maid's Guild that used to work at the Belfast Mansion before moving to Brunhild Dukedom.

God, later called the God of Worlds is an Omnipotent God who controls what occurs in the world that Touya currently resides in, as well as his previous world. When he come down to the world, he posed as Touya's grandfather and uses Shinnosuke Mochizuki as his name.
Originally a homeless pickpocketer, but after Touya rescued her from two other pickpockets going after her because of a territory problem, he decided to hire her to be a maid.

node.description:
Satan Jacob is the main protagonist of the series. He was once the Demon King who declared war on Ente Isla in an attempt to annex the four continents. However, due to the actions of the Hero [Emilia Justina](https://anilist.co/character/70735) and her companions, he was forced to retreat to Earth, causing him to lose almost all of his powers.

Satan was well-known throughout Ente Isla as the great overlord of his people, his name synonymous with the terror and cruelty his army brought to those unfortunate enough to fall victim. He allowed his minions the right to perform any heinous acts they deemed fit, showing immense cruelty through the slaughter of many innocent humans in his conquest. By contrast, on Earth Sadao Maou is shown to be a diligent and proactive employee, instead applying his strong drive and determination to better himself in his new life. Forced to spend time living as a human and interacting with those he previously considered to be lesser beings, he has since developed a kindhearted and cheerful disposition making him popular among both his colleagues and neighbors. He now strives to climb the corporate ladder at MgRonald's.

~!Though he is not the legendary Satan spoken of in the Ente Islan Bible, Satan Jacob was given the name at birth, as it has since become an extremely common name among demons. While he once belonged to a lowly goblin-class tribe, Satan's family and comrades were slaughtered in a conflict between demons, the enemy having left him behind to die following the carnage. While lying motionless on the ground awaiting his eventual demise, he was found and rescued by a mysterious angel, who chose to care for the child and ensure his survival. The stranger claimed she had never seen a demon crying before and nursed him back to health, sharing with him many stories and her knowledge of humankind. Through her stories, he became instilled with a desire to unite his own kind the same way that humans had done in the past.!~

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name.native: エミリア・ユスティーナ

node.description:
Emilia is the main female protagonist and the Hero who defeated the [Demon King Satan](https://anilist.co/character/70733). After forcing the Demon King to retreat from Ente Isla, she followed him to modern day Japan to ensure his destruction. However, just like the Demon Lord, she lost most of her powers upon her arrival and was forced to assume a Japanese name. She was also forced to find employment, and so became a call center agent. She is a half human and half angel.

Overall, Emi is a strong-willed and determined hero, displaying many admirable qualities befitting of one in her position; among which are a pure heart, boundless courage, unwavering loyalty to those closest to her, and a deep-seated desire to protect the innocent. Moreover, she lacks self-confidence and gets angry/frustrated easily. While initially hesitant to become the great hero of Ente Isla, the death of her father at the hands of [Lucifer](https://anilist.co/character/83103)'s Army ignited a fire in the heart of the young hero, giving her a motivation to train harder and strike down those who destroyed her village. Due to her personal losses, she sees all demons as her enemy, most of all their leader, Satan Jacob.

~!Emilia Justina was born to her parents, an ordinary farmer named Nord Justina and the archangel Lailah. Knowing she had committed a taboo by birthing a child to a human, her mother fled, leaving Emilia to be raised by her father on his farm located somewhere on the Western Continent. During Satan's conquest, the child lived a peaceful life with her father. Despite fearing the day they would be accosted by the encroaching demon army, he assured her that their village would be protected by the Church, putting her mind at ease. Her life changed drastically one afternoon when representatives from the Ente Islan Church arrived at her home to train Emilia as the Hero who could free the world of the Demon King Satan. Although reluctant at first, Emilia's motivation was fueled when she received news of her father's apparent death when the Demon King's army laid waste to their fields only days after her departure. In reality, Nord Justina was taken by Lailah and hidden safely on Earth during this time, though Emilia remained unaware of her father's true fate.!~

Lucifer is a fallen angel and one of the Demon King's generals. After his defeat at the hands of Hero Emilia, he was secretly rescued by Olba Meyer, who promised to return Lucifer to heaven if they became allies in defeating the Demon Lord. After being defeated by the Demon Lord, Urushihara moved in with Sadao Maou and Ashiya.

Lucifer is shown to be cunning and sneaky as well as a childish, preferring to surf the internet and play video games rather than help Ashiya with the housework. Due to his attitude, everyone tends to treat him lightly and pay no mind to many of his protests at being excluded from things. Lucifer is also self-proclaimed socially awkward, lazy to an extent, and has a short temper. However, it seems he has hidden feelings beneath his seemingly irresponsible and carefree attitude, and shows his serious side from time to time. To his irritation, Lucifer is usually referred to as a hikikomori even when among company.

~!Known as the "original sin" and the son of Ignora, Lucifer was born after the destruction of the angels' home-world, making him part of the second generation of his kind. Once an honored and revered archangel, he was tasked with the responsibility of leading the archangels. Lucifer eventually abandoned his job, feeling it was too boring in heaven for him to remain. Losing his former status and gaining black wings signifying his corruption, his powers became demonic, reclassifying him a fallen angel. Lucifer traveled to the Demon Realm where he would remain for several years. During his time among the warring demonic tribes, Lucifer gained a certain amount of power and influence over his new compatriots, though was still not considered a "pure" demon due to his celestial origins. He would later join the young Satan Jacob in his plot to unite the demon realm under his flag, the rising monarch proclaiming that Lucifer should feel free to kill him if he ever felt displeased with his leadership.!~

(Source: Hataraku Maou-sama Wikia, edited)

Alciel is one of Satan's Demon Generals and was also transported to modern day Japan with him. Extremely loyal to Maou, he takes care of the domestic duties at home and goes to the library to research ways for Maou and himself to regain their powers.

Back in Ente Isla, Alciel was known widely as the right hand of King Satan and a master strategist, making him both a trusted adviser and top military commander to the ruler of the Demon Realm. However, he shared his leader's belief that humans lives are meaningless and expendable, considering demonkind to be superior beings and showing a strong sense of pride bordering on extreme arrogance. 

While living in Japan, Ashiya has come to accept his rather mundane life, though he still openly laments how low they have fallen since arriving on Earth, and still tends to consider humans as beneath him. Due to their lack of sufficient funds and personal comforts, Ashiya has become incredibly tightfisted and strict about the household budget. One part of him that has not changed, though, is his extreme dedication and loyalty to the Demon King.

(Source: Hataraku Maou-sama Wikia, edited)

Chiho is Maou's friend and a fellow employee at MgRonald's. She has a crush on Maou. She can hear and understand the language of Ente Isla, after receiving feedback from a hypnosis spell that Maou cast on her father, Inspector Sasaki.

She has a strong will and a polite, friendly, pleasant all around personality. She is head over heels for Maou, and sometimes gets jealous when she sees Emi and Maou together.

She is a part-time employee at MgRonald's along with Maou. Maou had met her father when he first landed on Earth, as her father is a policeman and caught him and Ashiya loitering around. Chiho attends school at Sasahata North High School.

She is the chief interrogator and executioner for the Church Investigation Commission, who came into the human realm from Ente Isla to check on reports about Emi's alliance with Maou. Unknown to Maou who she is, she becomes his next door neighbor and eventually became close, being a good cook she would drop by in Maou's apartment to  prepare meals for everyone. She knows little about the human realm especially in Tokyo that she is having difficulty going around the city and understanding people's sense of fashion.   ~! It seems since the start that Maou and Lucifer knew who she was. !~  (Source:  Animefreak)

Alas Ramus is the appointed daughter of Sadao Maou and Emi Yusa. 

~!She is a fragment of Yesod, one of the elements of Sephiroth.!~
She is Maou's immediate superior at MgRonalds where he works.
Emi's coworker.

name.native: エメラダ・エトゥーヴァ

node.description: Emi's friend from Ente Isla.
Acieth Alla is the younger sister of [Alas Ramus](https://anilist.co/character/158748) and the adoptive daughter of [Nord](https://anilist.co/character/83471). ~!She is also a Fragment of Yesod.!~

Amane Ooguro is the niece of [Miki Shiba](https://anilist.co/character/83461) who was the temporary shop owner of "Ooguro-ya". ~!She is the Daughter of "Understanding" of Earth, thus labeling her as a guardian of Earth.!~

He was introduced in ep. 8 as the manager of Sentucky Fired Chicken or SFC, MgRonald's rival fast food chain in Hatagaya district. He apparently has a thing for beautiful girls.   ~!His true identity is the archangel Sariel, who came to Japan to retrieve Emi's sword, "Better Half".!~
Gabriel (ガブリエル Gaburieru) is a first generation Archangel from Ente Isla who commands the lower ranking angels.

**Miki** is the landlord at the place the Devil King stays, "Villa Rosa Sasazuka". She requested that her apartment be rented out to "shady characters" such as Maou and Alciel. She seems to have some knowledge of Ente Isla.

~!She is a guardian of the Earth and is thought to be incredibly powerful to the point where Sariel and Gabriel did not strike Villa Rosa Sasazuka out of fear of provoking her. She is older than any known archangels in history.!~

(Source: Hataraku Maou-sama Wikia)
An archangel and [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/70735/Emilia-Justina)'s mother.
One of the comrades of Yusa, Emi on attacking the Dark Lord's castle.
Chiho's classmate, who seemly has an affinity for boy's love.
Camio Is the Minister of the Demon World and the Deputy Demon King during Satan's absence.
**First appearance:** Episode 10 as the Manager of MgRonalds at the Fushima Park branch.

name.native: ノルド・ユスティーナ

node.description: [Emilia's](https://anilist.co/character/70735) father. ~!He was thought to be dead, but it was revealed that he has been hiding in Japan under the name Sato Hiroshi!~
~!He is an ambitious high member of the church who came into the human world with Hanzou to seek and eliminate both Maou and Emi, so that he can be the sole ruler of  Ente Isla.!~  (Source: ANN)
Chiho's father.
Chiho's mother.

She is a part-time employee at MgRonald's along with Maou. Maou had met her father when he first landed on Earth, as her father is a policeman and caught him and Ashiya loitering around. Chiho attends school at Sasahata North High School.

sampleCharacters.name: Crestia Bell
sampleCharacters.description: She is the chief interrogator and executioner for the Church Investigation Commission, who came into the human realm from Ente Isla to check on reports about Emi's alliance with Maou. Unknown to Maou who she is, she becomes his next door neighbor and eventually became close, being a good cook she would drop by in Maou's apartment to prepare meals for everyone. She knows little about the human realm especially in Tokyo that she is having difficulty going around the city and understanding people's sense of fashion. ~! It seems since the start that Maou and Lucifer knew who she was. !~ (Source: Animefreak)

sampleCharacters.name: Alas Ramus
sampleCharacters.description: Alas Ramus is the appointed daughter of Sadao Maou and Emi Yusa. ~!She is a fragment of Yesod, one of the elements of Sephiroth.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Mayumi Kisaki
sampleCharacters.description: She is Maou's immediate superior at MgRonalds where he works.

sampleCharacters.name: Acieth Alla
sampleCharacters.description: Acieth Alla is the younger sister of [Alas Ramus](https://anilist.co/character/158748) and the adoptive daughter of [Nord](https://anilist.co/character/83471). ~!She is also a Fragment of Yesod.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Amane Ooguro
sampleCharacters.description: Amane Ooguro is the niece of [Miki Shiba](https://anilist.co/character/83461) who was the temporary shop owner of "Ooguro-ya". ~!She is the Daughter of "Understanding" of Earth, thus labeling her as a guardian of Earth.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Mitsuki Sarue
sampleCharacters.description: He was introduced in ep. 8 as the manager of Sentucky Fired Chicken or SFC, MgRonald's rival fast food chain in Hatagaya district. He apparently has a thing for beautiful girls. ~!His true identity is the archangel Sariel, who came to Japan to retrieve Emi's sword, "Better Half".!~

sampleCharacters.name: Gabriel
sampleCharacters.description: Gabriel (ガブリエル Gaburieru) is a first generation Archangel from Ente Isla who commands the lower ranking angels.

sampleCharacters.name: Miki Shiba
sampleCharacters.description: **Miki** is the landlord at the place the Devil King stays, "Villa Rosa Sasazuka". She requested that her apartment be rented out to "shady characters" such as Maou and Alciel. She seems to have some knowledge of Ente Isla. ~!She is a guardian of the Earth and is thought to be incredibly powerful to the point where Sariel and Gabriel did not strike Villa Rosa Sasazuka out of fear of provoking her. She is older than any known archangels in history.!~ (Source: Hataraku Maou-sama Wikia)

sampleCharacters.name: Lyra
sampleCharacters.description: An archangel and [Emilia](https://anilist.co/character/70735/Emilia-Justina)'s mother.

sampleCharacters.description: One of the comrades of Yusa, Emi on attacking the Dark Lord's castle.
