node.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm

Kurumi is the third spirit who appeared after [Tohka](https://anilist.co/character/65259) and [Yoshino](https://anilist.co/character/70603). She has a split personality: that of a gentle, mysterious highschool girl with a slow talking pattern, and that of a psychopathic killer. She is very aggressive in her actions which makes it harder for [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257) to capture her.

~!Kurumi has the archangel Zafkiel, and has the power to control over time. The reason why she keeps appearing after being killed by [Mana](https://anilist.co/character/72283) countless times was because of her powers. For example, she can heal herself by turning back the time. She uses a gunblade as her weapon. Though she always keeps getting killed by Mana, Kurumi from a different time period appeared and was considered as the most deadly of all took down Mana, Tohka, and [Origami](https://anilist.co/character/65261) at near end of volume 3. It is said that her ultimate goal is to get the powers of the spirit inside Shidou to kill the very first spirit who appeared 30 years ago to make all spirits disappear from this world. Her angel is destroyed by [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263) in volume 4.!~

~!The twelve Roman numerals on the clock in her left eye have different powers that only the original Kurumi can use, but by using their powers, it will cause her life to be eaten away. In order to avoid this, she kills people to obtain 'time'.!~

__Code name:__ Princess
__Height:__ 155 cm

Tooka Yatogami's name is given by [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257/Itsuka-Shidou) the second time they met. Due to being a spirit, she is always being targeted by the AST and is aiming for the kill; because of this, she hated humans for always shunning her and thinking that she wasn't allowed to live in this world. However, her whole life changed when she met Shidou.  Even with that high and cool presence, Tooka lacks some common sense and loves food very much.

~!Once her power was sealed, she wasn't being targeted by the AST anymore, and she started attending Shidou's high school. Her surname was given by [Reine](https://anilist.co/character/72281/Murasame-Reine).  She was overjoyed that she could live with Shidou now, but knowing that [Origami](https://anilist.co/character/65261/Tobiichi-Origami) was there too, she was somehow agitated and is always having a minor quarrel with Origami (mostly because of Shidou and their feelings).!~

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

__Height:__ 152 cm 

Origami Tobiichi is a student of Raizen High School, she is known for having high grades in her entire high school, while she is studying at this high school she is also a member of AST (Anti-Spirit Team) and she's one of the most skilled ones on their team.   

~!Origami is in love with [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257), her love for Shidou is greatly high that she stalks him. Origami met Shidou 5 years ago when the first great space quake happened. Although Shidou doesn't remember it due to his memories being erased by a certain spirit.  Origami has a great hatred towards spirits; 5 years ago when the first great space quake happened both of her parents died due to a flame spirit appearing causing every houses to burn and fall.  At the end of Volume 3 Origami saw the flame spirit (which was [Kotori Itsuka](https://anilist.co/character/65263)) she assumed it was the spirit that killed her parents but on Volume 4 that assumption was cleared by Shidou saying that there was another spirit lingering at the time the incident 5 years ago occurred.!~

__Height:__ 145 cm  

Kotori is [Shidou's](https://anilist.co/character/65257) foster sister. Kotori is the head commander of Ratatosk which teaches Shidou about the spirit and spacequakes happening. She told Shidou how to save the spirits in a peaceful manner so as to prevent the spacequake from happening.  Kotori has two modes which is depicted by the ribbon she wears. The white ribbon depicts the Imouto Mode which makes her show love for her brother. The black ribbon depicts the Commander Mode which shows her tsundere sadistic bossy nature.   

~!Kotori is actually a Fire Spirit. To be exact, she became a Spirit five years ago. The reason why Shidou regenerates his wound and comes back to life is because Shidou sealed Kotori's power inside him five years ago. It was around that time that there was a third entity which was said to be the cause of Kotori becoming a Spirit and the cause of [Mana](https://anilist.co/character/72283)'s, Kotori's and Shidou's memory to be erased.  Kotori's angel, Camael, contains the power of fire. Her weapon manifests itself as either a giant flaming axe or a heat cannon.!~

The second spirit saved by [Shido](https://anilist.co/character/65257/Itsuka-Shidou). Yoshino is a shy girl who is said to be the Kindest spirit up to date. Her codename is Hermit.   ~!Other than Yoshino, she has her other personality named Yoshinon which is the rabbit in her left arm. Yoshino says it's her hero for protecting her from bad guys (which are the ASTs). It is also said that Yoshino created Yoshinon in order to restrain herself from hurting humans.!~

__Height:__ 170 cm

Shidou Itsuka is a student of Raizen High School. He was adopted into the Itsuka family when he was "abandoned" by his mother.   ~!Shidou has the ability to seal a spirit's power. However, the reason why he possesses it is shrouded in mystery. Due to this power which was already known by Kotori Itsuka he was recruited--or rather forced--to join "Ratatoskr" to help and save Spirits. Instead of killing Spirits to prevent spacequake from happening, he has to seal the Spirit's powers with a kiss in order for them to co-exist with humans.  Shidou met his real sister at volume 3 which was [Mana Takamiya](https://anilist.co/character/72283). Shidou, Mana and [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263) can't remember much about what happened 5 years ago because a certain "Spirit/person" locked their memories away, and at that time Shidou met [Origami](https://anilist.co/character/65261) and helped her which was the cause as of why Origami fell for Shidou.  Once the power of a Spirit is sealed within Shidou, he has the ability to use some portion of it, thus his resurrection power is from Kotori's abilities when he sealed Kotori's Spirit 5 years ago.!~

__Angel:__ Haniel
__Height:__ 144 cm (normal), 170 cm (adult form)
__Rank:__ B-Class spirit 

Natsumi is the seventh Spirit to appear in the series. She first appears as a slender woman whose age should be slightly past 20 years old.

 ~!However, it is later revealed that her true form is a little girl with the appearance of a child with unkempt hair and clothing.!~

Miku is a Spirit who is an idol and lady. She hates men to the point that [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257) even has to crossdress in order to interact with her.

~!Just like [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263), Miku was a normal human before she became a Spirit. Her angel is Gabriel, and she has the power to manipulate and brainwash people.!~

~!Ever since she was little, Miku loved singing. She wasn't good at studying or sports, but she could sing better than anyone else around her. As an aspiring singer, she had always dreamed of performing on the big stage. That dream came true when she debuted as an idol singer at the age of 15, under the stage name Tsukino Yoimachi. It was the best thing that Miku could have wished for, doing the very thing she loved and being adored by her fans, she was having the time of her life. Her career however, came to an abrupt end just after about a year when she refused to, you know what, with a hotshot TV producer. Before Miku knew it, false scandals about her began appearing. She soon fell out of favour with her agency. Her fans started to hate her, and Miku thought that she could reconnect everything back with her singing, but she suddenly had lost her voice. As Miku contemplated suicide, Phantom appeared before her and made her a Spirit.!~

Often speaks in a robot-like speech pattern; when arguing with [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/86645/Yamai-Kaguya), Yuzuru always sneers at her and points out the flaw in Kaguya’s argument.

~!Yamai was originally one spirit, but for unknown reasons or causes that may be related with her coming and going between the dimensions sometime in the past; she was split into two bodies and mind. The original personality of Yamai is no more, as well as what type of personality she used to have is unknown to the split Yamais. The Yamai Sisters have been well known to the people who know about the existence of spirit because they often cause major storm in the area every time they come through to Earth.!~

name.native: ブリドカット・セーラ・恵美

node.description: Outgoing and out-spoken, one can say that she is childish or immature. Kaguya often speaks before considering what she is talking about.    ~!Yamai was originally one spirit, but for unknown reasons or causes that may be related with her coming and going between the dimensions sometime in the past; she was split into two bodies and mind. The original personality of Yamai is no more, as well as what type of personality she used to have is unknown to the split Yamais. The Yamai Sisters have been well known to the people who know about the existence of spirit because they often cause major storm in the area every time they come through to Earth. !~

__Height:__ 148 cm
__Angel:__ Michael

She is the tenth spirit to appear in the series. Mukuro speaks in an overly archaic style. She often speaks in a third person perspective by referring to herself as "Muku" (むく).

~!After having her emotions unlocked, Mukuro regained her true personality, which in contrast to her sealed one, is very emotional. Due to growing up as an orphan, Mukuro fears to be alone again and desperately wants to remain attached to those who she believes loves her. Even after going as far as to seal the other Spirits' memories of him, [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257/) describes her intentions as being motivated by pure love and innocence rather than any true ill will.!~

~!Mukuro once was a lonely child that grew up with no family. In her solitude, she concluded that people blessed with a family were special, and she could not be considered special. However, one day, she was adopted by a couple who wanted a child. They, along with an older sister, would soon become a family to her. For a while, she lived in bliss under the warmth of a family. Her sister would complement her hair while styling it, and they often went stargazing together, as she recited the lore of each constellation to her. However, one day while visiting Tenguu Tower, her sister brought along a friend, who commented that Mukuro needed to cut her hair. Hurt by how her sister had changed from always praising her golden hair, she concluded that her sister had loved her friend more than her.!~

__Height:__ 164 cm

She is highly intelligent and the Analysis Officer of Ratatosk's Fraxinus Crew.  She can be more called as the Vice Commander of the crew rather than [Kannazuki Kyouhei](https://anilist.co/character/75394), it is usually her at the side of [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263) managing things around the crew. She transferred to Raizen Highschool as a physics teacher and an assistant home-room teacher at [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257)'s class. She has this very big eyebags which you can tell she hasn't been sleeping for years.

~!At some point of time she can be reliable and take command of the directions which Shidou needs to do when dating a spirit. She acts like the "mother" of Shidou and the other Spirits to help them on their troubles and such.!~

__Height:__ 168 cm
__Angel:__ Rasiel

She is the ninth Spirit to appear in the series.

~!Nia, also known as the Second Spirit, is a Spirit that appeared on Earth some time after the First Spirit appeared and is claimed to be the only one who knows any information about the First Spirit and her whereabouts. At some point, the D.E.M. captured her by unknown means and she fell into a comatose state.!~

~!The First Spirit was the first Spirit to ever make an appearance on Earth. 30 years before the beginning of the events in Date A Live, she was summoned into the world by Sir Isaac Ray Pelham Westcott, Ellen Mira Mathers, and Elliot Baldwin Woodman through unknown means. However, her summoning also caused the first spacequake in history at some point of the frontier between China and Mongolia, killing over 150 million people and starting a chain of similar disasters around the world that would last approximately six months.!~

One of the Wizards of DEM (Deus Ex Machina), an organization which provides realizer units to other wizards throughout the world to fend off spirits. When DEM was transferred to Tenguu City's AST, she was posted on that spot to deal with the Spirit called Nightmare. Mana doesn't recall much of her past and it is said that she's one of the best wizards existing.   ~!In Volume 3 it is revealed that Mana is [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257)'s blood-related sister; though she can't recall much of her past 5 years ago. She has a photo of her and Shidou that reveals that Shidou is her brother. Even though Mana is one of the best wizards existing, DEM has been experimenting on her body via tests and drugs; making her capable of using other tools meant to kill Spirits. It takes a side effect on her body, but she herself doesn't know it.!~  ~!In Volume 4 she was taken into Ratatoskr for custody; in Volume 5 she joins Ratatoskr.!~

name.native: エレン・ミラ・メイザース

node.description: Reportedly she is the world's strongest Wizard who works for Sir Isaac Ray Peram Westcott personally and is often mistaken for being his assistant. She has previously worked for the AST by request of Sir Isaac Ray Peram Westcott. She has vowed to never lose to any opponent, even agreeing that she may go so far as to commit the atrocity of destroying the world in the process.  (Source: Wikipedia)

__Height:__ 181cm

Vice Commander of Ratatoskr. Other information is still unknown except for the fact that he's a masochist and like the other crew members, he loves and respects his Commander, Kotori.  He can be stupid, but when it comes to it he acts accordingly to what needs to be done.

~!The Fraxinus AI. After the ship's upgrade to Fraxinus EX, she gains the ability to talk to the crew members. During the final battle with DEM, she was able to gain a physical form through Nia's powers.(Source: Date A Live Wiki)!~
**Mii Fujibakama** is a member of the female trio that Tohka is friends with.

name.native: アルテミシア・ベル・アシュクロフト

node.description: ~!Artemisia is one of the top five wizards in the entire world. She made a proper appearance in Volume 13 as the new Adeptus 2, replacing Mana, and was there to guard Westcott alongside Ellen. (Source: Date A Live Wiki)!~
~!A pseudo Spirit created through a combination of DEM's technology and Westcott's <Beelzebub>. !~
Captain of the Japan Ground Self Defense Force (JGSDF) Anti-Spirit Team (AST) who leads the young girls of the AST while being 27 herself.  (Source: Wikipedia)

__Height:__ 150 cm
__Relatives:__ [Mikie Okamine](https://anilist.co/character/85561/Okamine-Mikie) (Cousin), ~![Kyouhei Kannazuki](https://anilist.co/character/75394/Kannazuki-Kyouhei) (Husband)!~

[Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257)'s homeroom teacher. Despite being 29 years old, she is still single. Always, when something dangerous happens, Tamae has a habit of panicking non-stop.

~!Tamae fell mutually in love at first sight with Kannazuki during a marriage interview party. Ideally, his looks fulfilled her dreams of being swept away by a princely figure. As of Volume 21, Tamae is currently wearing a ring symbolizing her engagement with Kannazuki.!~

name.native: アイザック・レイ・ペラム・ウェストコット

node.description: The managing director of DEM Industries, He is around 30 years old and a tall man with dark ash blond hair and sharp eyes.

sampleCharacters.name: Natsumi
sampleCharacters.description: __Angel:__ Haniel __Height:__ 144 cm (normal), 170 cm (adult form) __Rank:__ B-Class spirit Natsumi is the seventh Spirit to appear in the series. She first appears as a slender woman whose age should be slightly past 20 years old. ~!However, it is later revealed that her true form is a little girl with the appearance of a child with unkempt hair and clothing.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Miku Izayoi
sampleCharacters.description: Miku is a Spirit who is an idol and lady. She hates men to the point that [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257) even has to crossdress in order to interact with her. ~!Just like [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263), Miku was a normal human before she became a Spirit. Her angel is Gabriel, and she has the power to manipulate and brainwash people.!~ ~!Ever since she was little, Miku loved singing. She wasn't good at studying or sports, but she could sing better than anyone else around her. As an aspiring singer, she had always dreamed of performing on the big stage. That dream came true when she debuted as an idol singer at the age of 15, under the stage name Tsukino Yoimachi. It was the best thing that Miku could have wished for, doing the very thing she loved and being adored by her fans, she was having the time of her life. Her career however, came to an abrupt end just after about a year when she refused to, you know what, with a hotshot TV producer. Before Miku knew it, false scandals about her began appearing. She soon fell out of favour with her agency. Her fans started to hate her, and Miku thought that she could reconnect everything back with her singing, but she suddenly had lost her voice. As Miku contemplated suicide, Phantom appeared before her and made her a Spirit.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Yuzuru Yamai
sampleCharacters.description: Often speaks in a robot-like speech pattern; when arguing with [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/86645/Yamai-Kaguya), Yuzuru always sneers at her and points out the flaw in Kaguya’s argument. ~!Yamai was originally one spirit, but for unknown reasons or causes that may be related with her coming and going between the dimensions sometime in the past; she was split into two bodies and mind. The original personality of Yamai is no more, as well as what type of personality she used to have is unknown to the split Yamais. The Yamai Sisters have been well known to the people who know about the existence of spirit because they often cause major storm in the area every time they come through to Earth.!~
voiceActors: ブリドカット・セーラ・恵美

sampleCharacters.name: Kaguya Yamai
sampleCharacters.description: Outgoing and out-spoken, one can say that she is childish or immature. Kaguya often speaks before considering what she is talking about. ~!Yamai was originally one spirit, but for unknown reasons or causes that may be related with her coming and going between the dimensions sometime in the past; she was split into two bodies and mind. The original personality of Yamai is no more, as well as what type of personality she used to have is unknown to the split Yamais. The Yamai Sisters have been well known to the people who know about the existence of spirit because they often cause major storm in the area every time they come through to Earth. !~

sampleCharacters.name: Mukuro Hoshimiya
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 148 cm __Angel:__ Michael She is the tenth spirit to appear in the series. Mukuro speaks in an overly archaic style. She often speaks in a third person perspective by referring to herself as "Muku" (むく). ~!After having her emotions unlocked, Mukuro regained her true personality, which in contrast to her sealed one, is very emotional. Due to growing up as an orphan, Mukuro fears to be alone again and desperately wants to remain attached to those who she believes loves her. Even after going as far as to seal the other Spirits' memories of him, [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257/) describes her intentions as being motivated by pure love and innocence rather than any true ill will.!~ ~!Mukuro once was a lonely child that grew up with no family. In her solitude, she concluded that people blessed with a family were special, and she could not be considered special. However, one day, she was adopted by a couple who wanted a child. They, along with an older sister, would soon become a family to her. For a while, she lived in bliss under the warmth of a family. Her sister would complement her hair while styling it, and they often went stargazing together, as she recited the lore of each constellation to her. However, one day while visiting Tenguu Tower, her sister brought along a friend, who commented that Mukuro needed to cut her hair. Hurt by how her sister had changed from always praising her golden hair, she concluded that her sister had loved her friend more than her.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Reine Murasame
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 164 cm She is highly intelligent and the Analysis Officer of Ratatosk's Fraxinus Crew. She can be more called as the Vice Commander of the crew rather than [Kannazuki Kyouhei](https://anilist.co/character/75394), it is usually her at the side of [Kotori](https://anilist.co/character/65263) managing things around the crew. She transferred to Raizen Highschool as a physics teacher and an assistant home-room teacher at [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257)'s class. She has this very big eyebags which you can tell she hasn't been sleeping for years. ~!At some point of time she can be reliable and take command of the directions which Shidou needs to do when dating a spirit. She acts like the "mother" of Shidou and the other Spirits to help them on their troubles and such.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Nia Honjou
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 168 cm __Angel:__ Rasiel She is the ninth Spirit to appear in the series. ~!Nia, also known as the Second Spirit, is a Spirit that appeared on Earth some time after the First Spirit appeared and is claimed to be the only one who knows any information about the First Spirit and her whereabouts. At some point, the D.E.M. captured her by unknown means and she fell into a comatose state.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Mio
sampleCharacters.description: ~!The First Spirit was the first Spirit to ever make an appearance on Earth. 30 years before the beginning of the events in Date A Live, she was summoned into the world by Sir Isaac Ray Pelham Westcott, Ellen Mira Mathers, and Elliot Baldwin Woodman through unknown means. However, her summoning also caused the first spacequake in history at some point of the frontier between China and Mongolia, killing over 150 million people and starting a chain of similar disasters around the world that would last approximately six months.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Mana Takamiya
sampleCharacters.description: One of the Wizards of DEM (Deus Ex Machina), an organization which provides realizer units to other wizards throughout the world to fend off spirits. When DEM was transferred to Tenguu City's AST, she was posted on that spot to deal with the Spirit called Nightmare. Mana doesn't recall much of her past and it is said that she's one of the best wizards existing. ~!In Volume 3 it is revealed that Mana is [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257)'s blood-related sister; though she can't recall much of her past 5 years ago. She has a photo of her and Shidou that reveals that Shidou is her brother. Even though Mana is one of the best wizards existing, DEM has been experimenting on her body via tests and drugs; making her capable of using other tools meant to kill Spirits. It takes a side effect on her body, but she herself doesn't know it.!~ ~!In Volume 4 she was taken into Ratatoskr for custody; in Volume 5 she joins Ratatoskr.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Ellen Mira Mathers
sampleCharacters.description: Reportedly she is the world's strongest Wizard who works for Sir Isaac Ray Peram Westcott personally and is often mistaken for being his assistant. She has previously worked for the AST by request of Sir Isaac Ray Peram Westcott. She has vowed to never lose to any opponent, even agreeing that she may go so far as to commit the atrocity of destroying the world in the process. (Source: Wikipedia)

Other information is still unknown except for the fact that he's a masochist and like the other crew members, he loves and respects his Commander, Kotori. He can be stupid, but when it comes to it he acts accordingly to what needs to be done.

sampleCharacters.description: ~!The Fraxinus AI. After the ship's upgrade to Fraxinus EX, she gains the ability to talk to the crew members. During the final battle with DEM, she was able to gain a physical form through Nia's powers.(Source: Date A Live Wiki)!~

sampleCharacters.name: Tamae Okamine
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 150 cm __Relatives:__ [Mikie Okamine](https://anilist.co/character/85561/Okamine-Mikie) (Cousin), ~![Kyouhei Kannazuki](https://anilist.co/character/75394/Kannazuki-Kyouhei) (Husband)!~ [Shidou](https://anilist.co/character/65257)'s homeroom teacher. name.native: アリスリーゼ・ルゥ・ネビュリス9世

node.description:
Aliceliese is a calm person and a kind heart to which she uses mostly to protect her family legacy. While she comes off as a cold fighter when she's on the battlefield, Aliceliese isn't much different from a normal girl her age. She enjoys going to the opera (having cried during one play), and is a fan of art and can be very talkative at times.

Being a teenage girl, Alice has some interest in the opposite sex. Not having many males her age around her, she expresses most of this interest in [Iska](https://anilist.co/character/170215/Iska) when they're not on the battlefield. She even treats their rivalry as something similar to a relationship, as [Rin](https://anilist.co/character/180987/Vispose-Rin) compared the way she was planning for their final battle to planning for a wedding.

Iska is the main protagonist of the series. He is the current wielder of the Astral Swords and is determined to end what he considers a pointless war. 

He was the youngest Saint Disciple to ever receive the title; but after releasing a "witch" from captivity, he was stripped of his rank and imprisoned for life. Circumstances around the war against the Nebulis Sovereignty have led to his release, but his goals haven't changed. 

Iska has a moral code that doesn’t discriminate, even if a supposed enemy is at hand. He shows kindness and bravery, despite putting himself at risk, and even willing to risk committing treason for them. On the battlefield, Iska becomes very fierce yet also calm, not being afraid of whatever power his opponent has or taking dangerous gambles to protect himself from their attacks. However, Iska usually avoids cutting down most opponents when he doesn't see any value in doing so, simply knocking them out. This has led Iska to be known as a 'peace-loving war nut'.

(Source: KimiSen Wiki)

name.native: シスベル・ルゥ・ネビュリス9世

node.description:
Sisbell is the third princess after [Aliceliese](https://anilist.co/character/170214/) and [Elletear](https://anilist.co/character/198582/) of the Nebulis Sovereignty.

Prior to the start of the anime, [Iska](https://anilist.co/character/170215/) and Sisbell knew each other when he freed her from the hands of the Heavenly Empire. After saving her from them, she found out that Iska was treated as a prisoner for being a traitor to the country. She was in disbelief at how he went on his way to treat a princess and stated that Sisbel only had weak astral power and was a little girl. With determination, she set out to find the whereabouts of her fated "dream knight" just to be captured by Lord Mask. Though, in the end of the anime, it was seen that Iska was being fought over by Alice and Sisbell, with Sisbell making a statement that he would be the perfect knight for the next queen.

Mismis is a supporting character in KimiSen. She is the captain of the 907th unit belonging to Iska's squad. She can be seen as a cute yet highly supportive teammate since her fighting skills are subpar to the other characters in her squad. Even though that she isn't highly smart with combat, she is usually the morale booster of their team, and gives everyone the emotional support that they need. She was formerly a human until she was sucked into the vortex where she got exposed. Her power included nullifying every astral mage's to use their abilities whenever she uses hers.

Being  the oldest person in their group, she acts and looks childish as she contains many stuff animals and cute dresses in her room. She also considers herself to be a girl rather than a woman and doesn't like it people call her a child.

Nene is a supporting character of the anime KimiSen. Along with Jhin, Iska and Mismis, they make up the members of the 907th unit with her specialty being able to graph coordinates of her target to a machine and releasing out projectiles to her enemies. She is a cheerful and high spirited girl that will help her teammates even if they go into such troubles, such as when Mismis became an Astral Mage after being exposed to a spirit vortex. She usually sees Iska as her brother and has a close relationship with her squad. Her weapons includes an anti-astral power grenade that disrupts the use of astral powers in a defined range, and has a ring that can indicate the position of her target.

node.description:
Elletear is one of the princesses and the older sister to Alice and Sisbell. She dons a heterochromatic eye where her left eye is colored Gold, her right eye contains a Light Blue hue, and in the manga, she has green eyes.

~!Inside her personality that appears to look like a responsible among the princesses, she hides under a bravado where she's a manipulative individual that is trying to overthrow her mother who is also the Queen of the Sovereignty due to being neglected in the past and being treated as an individual with weak sense of astral power. Because of that, she will go out of her way to feed false information to the masked Man just so that her plan would succeed. Additionally, she is also an accomplice and acts as the main antagonist along with the eight great apostles who raised an attack against an independent nation should they either side with them or the sovereignty.!~

Jhin is part of the 907th unit and serves as a sniper. He is shown to be a calm and collected individual, along with being the smartest among them. He usually makes sarcastic remarks, often making a witty remark, but he tends to care a lot for his comrades in his squad.

~!Jhin was selected by Crosswell to find the successor of the sword. Due to the reason that Jhin was good in range, Crosswell awsn't able to teach him other than the gun theory since Crosswell's specialty was being a swordsman. It means that Jhin would have to work hard with perseverance if he wants to learn how to wield the strongest swords that Crosswell wanted to find a successor. Ultimately, it was then that Iska and Jhin knew each other and became best friends.!~

node.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm

Hitagi, the main female character, is a weak-looking girl with an "incurable disease". She is in the same class as [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi), but he has almost never heard her speak. When she was in the first year of high school, she encountered a mysterious crab, after which she became weightless. Ever since, she has avoided contact with everyone else, threatening everyone who discovers her secret. She called herself a tsundere and always speaks in an abusive style.

~!At the end of Mayoi Snail, she admits that she loves Koyomi, and subsequently enters into a relationship with him.!~

~!After the events in Tsukihi Phoenix, she overcame all of her trauma, and became a rather cheerful and normal girl. She starts calling Araragi with a cute nickname, chuckling at small things and sending e-mails full of Emojis, although her sharp tongue is still there, but toned down.!~

~!Hitagi has told [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Hanekawa-Tsubasa) that she suffers from an Electra Complex (when a girl has intense sexual attraction towards her father). Whether this was a joke or a sincere admission has remained unrevealed!~

alternative: Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade (キスショット・アセロラオリオン・ハートアンダーブレード)
Tekketsu ni shite Nekketsu ni shite Reiketsu no Kyuuketsuki (鉄血にして熱血にして冷血の吸血鬼)

node.description:
A girl who lives with [Oshino Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) in an abandoned building. She loves donuts from the Mister Donut chain. At the beginning of Hitagi Crab, she was renamed "Shinobu" by Meme, who suggested that the name Shinobu (忍), comprised of a heart (心) under a blade (刃), matched her original persona.

~!She appears to be an eight year old girl, but was originally a beautiful vampire who had lived for more than 500 years. After the events of Koyomi Vamp, she was left in a weakened condition with no powers or traces of her original personality, and therefore had to abandon her "Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade" name. Prior to being a vampire, she was a princess of unparalleled beauty. She was referred to as "Princess Beauty" or "Acerola" during this time, the latter being her original name. Eventually, she was turned into a vampire by Deathtopia Virtuoso Suicide-Master to save her from the curse of beauty.!~

__Height:__ 165 cm   

A third year high school student who is close to failing every class except math. He is a laid-back person whose only real friend at school is [Tsubasa Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Due to events prior to Kizumonogatari and Bakemonogatari, Koyomi avoided having friends and seemed to have lost faith and trust in people and himself.

~!During spring break, he gave [Kiss-Shot](https://anilist.co/character/23602/Shinobu-Oshino) his blood and became a vampire. Although [Meme Oshino](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) helped him become human again, there are a few lingering side effects; he can see in the dark and far distances, and he heals faster than the average human. He is still scared of morning sunlight even though it no longer has any effect on him.!~

__Height:__ 153 cm 

Nadeko, the main character of Nadeko Snake, is [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi)’s friend back in elementary school. She always wears a waist pouch, always casts her eyes downward, has her bangs covering her eyes, has a shy personality, and can be easily amused. [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) played with her a lot whenever she visited his house after being invited by his sisters. She refers to Koyomi as Koyomi onii-chan and appears to have feelings for him.   ~!She was cursed two times by a classmate who liked the boy she rejected, and the rejected boy. While the first one is banished, Koyomi is forced to battle the second to keep it from killing Nadeko.!~ She's quite protective of her hair (particularly her forelocks) thinking that it's her place to guard more than her panties. When she finally combed her forelocks aside in Nisemonogatari, Koyomi commented that she has a glare just like a serpent, probably foreshadowing the story of Nadeko Medusa.

In Nademonogatari, ~!Nadeko gains a power to draw, create, and then materialize shikigami, making her useful in the eyes of [Izuko Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/87115/Izuko-Gaen) and gets offered a job, thanks to [Yotsugi Ononoki](https://anilist.co/character/57499/Yotsugi-Ononoki)!~

Mayoi is a fifth-grade elementary school girl. She always carries a big backpack, wears a hairband, and sports ponytails.    ~!Ten years ago she was involved in a traffic accident and died because of it. After that she became a ghost and considers herself a "lost snail". She will unwillingly cause the people around her to become lost and unable to find their way home. The only people who can see her are people who don't want to go home in the first place. However, after [Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) and [Senjougahara](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara) help her find the home she was looking for, she changed from an "earthbound spirit" to a "wandering spirit", a fact that she considers to be a bonus, as well as granting her to be free to wander wherever she desires. At the end of Nisemonogatari, she said goodbye to Koyomi, implying that she will not be seeing him again, which will be the basis of the next story, Mayoi Jiangshi. Her family name before her parents got divorced was Tsunade.!~

Ougi appears to be a girl with short black hair, black pupils, and pale white skin. She is a junior of [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) at Naoetsu Private High School. Ougi often talks to Koyomi about oddities, and helping him remember what he knows. Her catchphrase is, "I don't know anything, Araragi-senpai. It's you who knows."

Ougi is mysterious and can come off as spooky/creepy. She also speaks in a condescending tone towards Koyomi and [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Furthermore, Ougi is capable of pulling off many things, despite what she says about what she knows.

~!As of Hanamonogatari and afterwards, chronologically, Ougi refers to himself as a boy. Others will question Ougi's identity when they first meet him as they knew him as a girl before, but they all shrug it off and seem to doubt themselves as to whether he was a girl before. An example being when [Suruga](https://anilist.co/character/22054/Suruga-Kanbaru) asks about it and was told that he has always been a boy since he was born. [Nadeko](https://anilist.co/character/22050/Nadeko-Sengoku) and Koyomi have also have a similar experience. Suruga herself refers to him as 'Ougi-kun', 'he', 'this guy', and 'the boy'. As of Musubi, Ougi seems to be a girl once again, now remaining in the classroom seen in Ougi Formula.!~ ~!The reasons for this seems to be due to Ougi connecting to Suruga after Koyomi graduates, therefore becoming her other side. Thus, Ougi becomes a boy and seems to pretend its the first time he meets everyone afterwards. After Suruga herself graduates, it's likely that Ougi no longer has anyone to connect to and becomes a girl that guides others in the odd classroom.!~

Suruga, the main character of Suruga Monkey, is [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi)'s underclassman, ace of the school's basketball team and one of [Hitagi](https://anilist.co/character/22037/Hitagi-Senjougahara)'s acquaintances from back in junior high school. Immediately after she entered senior high school, she became aware of Hitagi's secret and was threatened by her, just like Koyomi was. She's an admitted lesbian, fujoshi, lolicon and masochist. 

~!Back in elementary school, she inherited what she thought was a Monkey's Paw but was actually a Rainy Devil from her mother. She started stalking Koyomi after she discovered he was dating Hitagi. She becomes friends with Koyomi and Hitagi after Koyomi rids her of the Rainy Devil.!~ She also has been growing her hair longer since. Her next story was revealed to be Suruga Devil.

**Occupation:** Oddity Specialist

Yotsugi Ononoki is an expressionless human corpse tsukumogami and the shikigami familiar of [Yozuru Kagenui](https://anilist.co/character/57501/).

Despite appearing almost entirely stoic, she still has hinted at feeling genuine emotion. She's mentioned how she considers [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/) her friend on multiple occasions, such as when giving him advice "as a friend" as opposed to as an oddity specialist. She's also expressed how she wouldn't want to have to harm him despite needing to follow orders as a shikigami.

node.description:
Deathtopia is a purebred vampire, possibly being the longest living one known to man. She is very arrogant and prideful, urging others to use the name that she created for herself.  She is known for the long, bizarre names she creates. Her many deaths and lack of eating have caused her to shrink, much like Shinobu.

As a vampire, Deathtopia has created many minions, including Tropicalesque, and more notably, KissShot. She has had many minions in her life, but almost all of them have rebelled, besides Tropicalesque. Deathtopia, however, likes the minions that rebelled over how loyal Tropicalesque was. Deathtopia was also the one who had saved Princess Acerola from her curse of beauty. ~!Deathtopia had originally manifested through the hatred for a tyrant that was known as the "Corpse King," who resided in the Corpse Castle. The king had caused many deaths in the long-forgotten kingdom, eventually being overthrown, and the subjects moving to another castle. Deathtopia, after manifesting, resided in the Corpse Castle as her new home.!~

Shinomonogatari Vol. 1: ~!After KissShot had left to her own endeavours, Deathtopia had at some point consumed the remnants of Tropicalesque. After Deathtopia saved Acerola from her curse and turned her into a vampire, Acerola's curse went dormant within her.
In the modern-day, Deathtopia is near-death from a virus that only infects and kills vampires. She looks like a withered tree and is near-death when Koyomi and Shinobu arrive at Corpse Castle and see her.
It's discovered that the vampire virus formed from Deathtopia's late thrall and servant, Tropicalesque, after his will merged with Acerola's dormant curse. However, it was still dormant for centuries, until Deathtopia met Shinobu again in Shinobumonogatari. It was then that Tropicalesque's primal hatred and jealousy flared up and began a desire to return Shinobu to a human. It ended up backfiring, leading to the deaths of vampires, along with the virus being unable to reach her and ultimately infecting his own master. 
To stop it from causing more harm and killing Deathtopia, Shinobu must suck it out of Deathtopia. This, in turn, turns her into a human, despite being purebred. Sometime after the fact, Deathtopia dies from the virus affecting humans, Covid. Shinobu says she had at least enjoyed the years as a human and didn't die from suicide, which is what she typically did die from.!~

Seiu is a member of the basketball team with Suruga Kanbaru. During her second year, she was the vice-captain. After Suruga retired due to the Rainy Devil's effects, Seiu became the captain. 

Seiu is a student at Naoetsu High and is in the same year as Kanbaru. She is often blunt, calling Kanbaru an idiot for having bad grades. As a friend of Kanbaru and fellow teammate of the basketball team, Kanbaru and Seiu are presumed to be somewhat close friends. As Kanbaru's friend, she has given her the nickname "Ruga." Initially, Seiu seems to be a background character, though she has a more prominent role in Monster Season.

~!In Shinobumonogatari, her name is read as "Seiu," though in Yoimonogatari, it is later read as "Hoshiame," where both having similar meanings. This was later brought up in Amarimonogatari, and it is said that, "both readings are correct, you can read them both ways." There has been no further info about why Higasa's name is like this.!~

A student at National University of Kyokuritsu Manase. Appears in "Shinobu Mastered/Mustard".
The first friend that Koyomi made after entering the university, who is not involved in any mysterious phenomena. She's not a mystery fanatic, but she likes to solve codes, so she takes a course in cryptology, and that's how they became friends.
She is a slow learner and is not good at changing her plans once she has made them, so she often sits idly in class when classes are cancelled. For some reason, she thinks very highly of Koyomi.

She's NISIOISIN's favorite character from Monogatari Series.

__Height:__ 170cm

1st Year student at Naoetsu Private High School and part of the Girls' Basketball Club. She's fed up with practices and her failing grades.~!Harimaze is the true perpetrator behind the failed vampirization of the members of the basketball team. She attacked the members after successfully becoming a vampire by the hands of [Deathtopia Virtuoso Suicide-Master](https://anilist.co/character/138020/Deathtopia-Virtuoso-SuicideMaster).!~

sampleCharacters.name: Shinobu Oshino
sampleCharacters.description: A girl who lives with [Oshino Meme](https://anilist.co/character/22552/Meme-Oshino) in an abandoned building. She loves donuts from the Mister Donut chain. At the beginning of Hitagi Crab, she was renamed "Shinobu" by Meme, who suggested that the name Shinobu (忍), comprised of a heart (心) under a blade (刃), matched her original persona. ~!She appears to be an eight year old girl, but was originally a beautiful vampire who had lived for more than 500 years. After the events of Koyomi Vamp, she was left in a weakened condition with no powers or traces of her original personality, and therefore had to abandon her "Kiss-Shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade" name. Prior to being a vampire, she was a princess of unparalleled beauty. She was referred to as "Princess Beauty" or "Acerola" during this time, the latter being her original name. Eventually, she was turned into a vampire by Deathtopia Virtuoso Suicide-Master to save her from the curse of beauty.!~

sampleCharacters.name: Nadeko Sengoku
sampleCharacters.description: __Height:__ 153 cm Nadeko, the main character of Nadeko Snake, is [Tsukihi](https://anilist.co/character/24195/Tsukihi-Araragi)’s friend back in elementary school. She always wears a waist pouch, always casts her eyes downward, has her bangs covering her eyes, has a shy personality, and can be easily amused. [Koyomi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) played with her a lot whenever she visited his house after being invited by his sisters. She refers to Koyomi as Koyomi onii-chan and appears to have feelings for him. ~!She was cursed two times by a classmate who liked the boy she rejected, and the rejected boy. While the first one is banished, Koyomi is forced to battle the second to keep it from killing Nadeko.!~ She's quite protective of her hair (particularly her forelocks) thinking that it's her place to guard more than her panties. When she finally combed her forelocks aside in Nisemonogatari, Koyomi commented that she has a glare just like a serpent, probably foreshadowing the story of Nadeko Medusa. In Nademonogatari, ~!Nadeko gains a power to draw, create, and then materialize shikigami, making her useful in the eyes of [Izuko Gaen](https://anilist.co/character/87115/Izuko-Gaen) and gets offered a job, thanks to [Yotsugi Ononoki](https://anilist.co/character/57499/Yotsugi-Ononoki)!~

sampleCharacters.name: Ougi Oshino
sampleCharacters.description: Ougi appears to be a girl with short black hair, black pupils, and pale white skin. She is a junior of [Koyomi Araragi](https://anilist.co/character/22036/Koyomi-Araragi) at Naoetsu Private High School. Ougi often talks to Koyomi about oddities, and helping him remember what he knows. Her catchphrase is, "I don't know anything, Araragi-senpai. It's you who knows." Ougi is mysterious and can come off as spooky/creepy. She also speaks in a condescending tone towards Koyomi and [Hanekawa](https://anilist.co/character/22055/Tsubasa-Hanekawa). Furthermore, Ougi is capable of pulling off many things, despite what she says about what she knows. ~!As of Hanamonogatari and afterwards, chronologically, Ougi refers to himself as a boy. Others will question Ougi's identity when they first meet him as they knew him as a girl before, but they all shrug it off and seem to doubt themselves as to whether he was a girl before. An example being when [Suruga](https://anilist.co/character/22054/Suruga-Kanbaru) asks about it and was told that he has always been a boy since he was born. [Nadeko](https://anilist.co/character/22050/Nadeko-Sengoku) and Koyomi have also have a similar experience. Suruga herself refers to him as 'Ougi-kun', 'he', 'this guy', and 'the boy'. As of Musubi, Ougi seems to be a girl once again, now remaining in the classroom seen in Ougi Formula.!~ ~!The reasons for this seems to be due to Ougi connecting to Suruga after Koyomi graduates, therefore becoming her other side. Thus, Ougi becomes a boy and seems to pretend its the first time he meets everyone afterwards. After Suruga herself graduates, it's likely that Ougi no longer has anyone to connect to and becomes a girl that guides others in the odd classroom.!~

node.description:
This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

__Species:__ God, Human (formerly)
~!__Affiliation:__ Humanity!~

Buddha has an easygoing attitude and does not seem to take anything seriously. His confidence is great enough for him to challenge [Zeus](https://anilist.co/character/140640/Zeus) to his face by claiming that the only one who can push him around in "all of heaven and Earth" is himself. Buddha also appears to have a sweet tooth as he was seen eating lollipops when walking and eating chocolates while relaxing.

Buddha also seems to display respect for other people by offering them foods he's currently eating, like when he didn't allow Zeus to steal one of his sweets, but offered his popcorn to [Brunhilde](https://anilist.co/character/140636/Brunhilde).

~!The human's representative for round 6!~

node.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Affiliation:__ Humanity 

Jack the Ripper, or Jack, is an infamous serial killer hailing from late 19th century Britain.

Normally, Jack has the disposition of a typical British Gentlemen, accentuated by his sophisticated diction and actions. However, Jack is a true sadist and monster at heart, being considered by most to be a person shrouded in malice and evil, murdering people as he considers the fear they feel before death to be absolutely beautiful. ~!Jack the Ripper is Humanity's representative in the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~

Qin Shi Huang was the founder of the Qin Dynasty and the first emperor to unify China. His real name is Ying Zheng. Qin Shi Huang, also known as Shi Huang Di, literally means "First Emperor of Qin". He is widely regarded as the greatest Chinese emperor of all time despite sometimes being viewed as a tyrant.

__Species__: Demigod

Brunhilde is the eldest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the main protagonist of the series.

She is the one who chose humanity's finest and strongest warriors in Ragnarok to stand up against the strongest gods in combat and slay them in an attempt to save Humanity.
Kojiro Sasaki's a famous swordsman from Japan, known as "History's Greatest Loser". ~!Kojiro Sasaki is Humanity's representative in the third round of Ragnarok.!~

__Affiliation:__ Gods

He is the current God of the Underworld also known as Helheim.

__Species__: God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Beelzebub is a prominent deity in the Philistine Pantheon and Abrahamic Pantheon. He is also the Lord of the Flies.
~!Beelzebub is the God's representative in the 8th round of Ragnarok.!~
Messenger of the gods.

The Gods' representative in the eleventh round of Ragnarok.
He is a prominent deity in the Norse Pantheon, known as the God of Mischief.

__Species:__ Demigod

Göll is the youngest of the 13 Valkyrie Sisters and the deuteragonist of the series. During the Ragnarok matches, she is usually seen with Brunhilde anxiously watching each match.

She's usually anxious and worried about many things to the point that it gets on Brunhilde's and Hrist's nerves. Whenever humanity's warriors die, she cries and mourns each of her sisters as they die with them.
As an apprentice valkyrie, she doesn't seem all that interested in saving humanity compared to worrying about her sisters.
Captain of the first unit of the Shinsengumi. ~!Souji Okita is Humanity's representative in the tenth round of Ragnarok.!~
Aphrodite is the Greek goddess of beauty.

__Species:__ God
__Affiliation:__ Gods

Zeus is a prominent deity and the Supreme God in the Greek Pantheon. He is also the chairman of the Gods' Council and often referred to as the "God Father of Cosmos"

When addressing his fellow gods, Zeus is extremely calm and authoritative while possessing a very formal and wise disposition. Like most gods, Zeus holds his own kind to a superior and extremely high standard, always expecting them to win no matter the odds, and seething with anger when they lose to humans. Zeus is also an eccentric individual, having random exaggerated emotional outbursts, breaking into a dance at the start of the second round of Ragnarok in front of everyone present, even being called the most shameful god by Hermes.

However, after several rounds of Ragnarok passed, Zeus became more humble, even acknowledging Humanity's strength. He is also extremely faithful and confident in those of the Greek Pantheon.

~!Zeus is the Gods' representative in the second round of Ragnarok.!~

The God of Misfortune.

Supreme god of Nordic.
The watchman of the apocalypse.

sampleCharacters.name: Buddha
sampleCharacters.description: __Species:__ God, Human (formerly) ~!__Affiliation:__ Humanity!~ Buddha has an easygoing attitude and does not seem to take anything seriously. His confidence is great enough for him to challenge [Zeus](https://anilist.co/character/140640/Zeus) to his face by claiming that the only one who can push him around in "all of heaven and Earth" is himself. Buddha also appears to have a sweet tooth as he was seen eating lollipops when walking and eating chocolates while relaxing. Buddha also seems to display respect for other people by offering them foods he's currently eating, like when he didn't allow Zeus to steal one of his sweets, but offered his popcorn to [Brunhilde](https://anilist.co/character/140636/Brunhilde). ~!The human's representative for round 6!~

sampleCharacters.name: Jack the Ripper
sampleCharacters.description: __Species:__ Human __Affiliation:__ Humanity Jack the Ripper, or Jack, is an infamous serial killer hailing from late 19th century Britain. Normally, Jack has the disposition of a typical British Gentlemen, accentuated by his sophisticated diction and actions. However, Jack is a true sadist and monster at heart, being considered by most to be a person shrouded in malice and evil, murdering people as he considers the fear they feel before death to be absolutely beautiful. ~!Jack the Ripper is Humanity's representative in the fourth round of Ragnarok.!~

node.description:
__Height:__ 162 cm  
__Instrument:__ Euphonium

Kumiko enrolled in Kitauji High School after long hoping to wear the uniform. She wasn't particularly dead set on it but decided to join the wind ensemble and continue playing the euphonium. She has a habit of immediately saying what she's thinking and changes her mind easily. She is very preoccupied with something she said to [Reina](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina) at a contest in junior high school.

__Height:__ 158 cm
__Instrument:__ Trumpet

A girl who graduated from the same junior high school as [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko). Influenced by her dad, who is a pro, she has been playing the trumpet since she was little, so she continues at the wind ensemble in high school. She is stoic and cool, and tends to keep herself distanced from other people.

__Height:__ 171 cm
__Instrument:__ Euphonium

A third-year high school student. She is the vice president of the brass band club, and also leads the bass section. Like Kumiko, she plays the euphonium. Her standoffish nature has brushed people off time and again. Her red-rimmed glasses are her trademark.

__Instrument:__ Oboe

Mizore is a second-year student who plays oboe. She is a very quiet and introverted girl, and despite seeming hard to interact with, she has friends like [Natsuki Nakagawa](https://anilist.co/character/88923/Nakagawa-Natsuki), [Yuuko Yoshikawa](https://anilist.co/character/88916/Yoshikawa-Yuuko), and - despite past relationship troubles - [Nozomi Kasaki](https://anilist.co/character/120724/Nozomi-Kasaki).

She likes practicing the oboe alone outside the classroom, and frequently arrives at school early, hours before the start of her classes, in order to practice. She's the only student to arrive at school even earlier than [Reina Kousaka](https://anilist.co/character/88710/Kousaka-Reina).

__Height:__ 156 cm
__Instrument:__ Euphonium

Natsuki is a reserved girl who is seen rarely talking, and she has an aloof and calm attitude. It is later revealed that the second-years are like this because of an event which occurred the year before [Kumiko Oumae](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko)'s first year at Kitauji.

However, Natsuki is normally friendly to everyone, and tends to be mature and calm in most situations. She is also understanding of situations and takes everything quite nicely.

__Instrument:__ Flute

Nozomi is a second-year student who used to play flute for the Kitauji High School's Bass Band Club in her first year. She and most of the first year members quit the club due to a conflict between the first-year members and the third-year members at that time.

Sound! Euphonium Season 2 Spoilers: ~!Nozomi tried to rejoin the band as well as get Asuka's approval. However, Asuka initially rejected due to the fear of Mizore possibly being affected by Nozomi's sudden return, causing a negative impact on Mizore's performance for the competition. However, due to an unexpected move by Nozomi to talk to Mizore causing her to run off, the latter managed to talk things out with Nozomi and restore their friendship. It is also revealed that Mizore played the oboe for the sole reason that it was the only thing that connected her with Nozomi.!~

Liz and the Blue Bird Spoilers: ~!In Liz and the Blue Bird, Mizore and Nozomi's relationship develops further. Mizore becomes less dependent on Nozomi and decides to go to a music school after graduating, while Nozomi decides to go to a regular university.!~

__Instrument:__ Euphonium

Kanade Hisaishi is a new first-year at Kitauji High School. She joins the band as a euphonium player in Kumiko's second year. 
Kanade has a courteous personality and great communication skills, and gives off a good impression to everyone who sees her. However, she has a secret side to her always-polite demeanor. Kumiko describes her as a "hypocritical courtesy" or a girl who is "superficially polite but rude in intent".

__Height:__ 156 cm
__Instrument:__ Trumpet

Yuuko is a nice, friendly and cheerful person who is also shown to have confidence, determination and a strong personality. She can openly and confidently show others what she is thinking through her actions, her facial expression, and her words.
However, Yuuko is also an emotional person as she can easily get annoyed or angered when something didn't go in the way she wants it to. Yuuko does acknowledges these flaws of her and tries to improve herself and gets over her own pride for the success of the band.
By nature, Yuuko will put great importance on the people she cares about that she will do anything she can to ensure their happiness and well-being. Sometimes, this leads her to make some mistakes but other times it elicits very noble actions from her. On the opposite, Yuuko behaves acerbically towards individuals she dislikes or someone she perceives as a threat to her cherished friends.

**Instrument:** Tuba

Kumiko's classmate. She was in the tennis club in junior high school, and is a beginner in music. She admired the trumpet and joined the wind ensemble, but ends up playing the tuba. She's a bright and perky mood-maker.

**Instrument:** Contrabass

Kumiko's classmate. At an elite junior high school for young ladies, she learned to play the contrabass. She joined the wind ensemble to continue to happily play music. She has a positive personality, but worries about her name.

(Source: Anime News Network)

__Height:__ 184cm

Taki is the new music teacher in Kitauji High School and serves as the adviser to the concert band club. He is also in charge of Class 5 of the second-year students. He is polite and has a methodical personality. He emphasizes independence in his students, and to this end he pushes them to reach their goal of going to the national competition.

__Instrument:__ Euphonium

She is a third-year transfer student from the prestigious Seira Girls School.

__Height:__ 163 cm (5'3")
__Instrument:__ Oboe

Ririka is a first-year student of Kitauji High School and an oboe player in Kitauji Concert Band Club.

She has a light and cheerful childlike personality who tries to build a good relationship with [Mizore](https://anilist.co/character/125960/). However, according to [Kanade](https://anilist.co/character/133462/), Ririka is aware of her ability to pass off any rude or suspicious behaviour as innocence with her smile. When Ririka's interested in something, she starts from the beginning and goes step by step.

Her special skill is making friends.

__Instrument__: Baritone Saxophone

A third-year high school student. She is the president of the brass band club, and also leads the saxophone section. She plays a baritone saxophone. She has a kind heart as she leads the Brass Band Club.

__Height:__ 166 cm
**Instrument:** Trumpet 

A third-year high school student. She leads the trumpet section and is the madonna of the Brass Band Club who everyone yearns for.

__Instrument:__ Trombone

Shuuichi is a first-year high school student. He is Kumiko's childhood friend, and the two went to the same junior high school. He and Kumiko are not classmates in high school because they are studying different courses. He was originally a French horn player, but he gets to play the trombone after winning a game of rock-paper-scissors.
Kumiko's older sister. She is a college student and was a trombone player in a brass band. She taught Kumiko to use a mouthpiece when she was a child.

__Instrument:__ Tuba

Suzume Kamaya is a new first-year student at Kitauji High School in Kumiko's third year and a member of the concert band who plays the tuba. Suzume loves her older sister, [Tsubame Kamaya](https://anilist.co/character/301973/Tsubame-Kamaya), very much

__Height:__ 161 cm
__Instrument:__ Clarinet

Sari Yoshii is a new first-year student at Kitauji High School in Kumiko's third year. She is a member of the concert band, and plays the clarinet.

__Height:__ 151 cm
__Instrument:__ Tuba

Satsuki Suzuki is a new first-year at Kitauji High School. She joins the band as a tuba player in Kumiko's second year. She is mostly friendly and cheerful who is a sociable person where she can become friends instantly with anyone.

__Instrument:__ Trombone

Kumiko's friend from junior high school. She admitted to Rikka High School, known for its marching band. She is the protagonist of the Rikka-centric spinoff novels.

She is a woodwind Instructor brought in by Noboru Taki to help with the Kitauji Concert Band on its path to the national competition. Her main instrument is flute, which she majored in, but she is also highly proficient in all other woodwind instruments. She is the youngest of the four instructors directing the band who is described as gentle with a sweet personality and her woodwind students describe her as a firm but good teacher.

As nice as she is outside of class, Niiyama is revealed to be as strict as Taki and Hashimoto during rehearsal and sectionals, setting extremely high standards for her students and forcing them to practice for hours every day.

__Height:__ 171 cm
__Instrument:__ Tuba

Mirei Suzuki is a new first-year at Kitauji High School. She joins the band as a tuba player in [Kumiko](https://anilist.co/character/88708/Oumae-Kumiko)'s second year. When Mirei was friends with [Satsuki](https://anilist.co/character/142965/Suzuki-Satsuki) in elementary school, they were called "Sacchan and Micchan", although she dislikes that nickname.

__Instrument:__ Percussion

Tsubame is a first year during Kumiko's first year. She is a fairly reserved and somewhat socially awkward girl. [Suzume Kamaya](https://anilist.co/character/330331/Suzume-Kamaya) is her younger sister.

He is the new percussion instructor for the Kitauji Concert Band, hired by Noboru Taki, his then college classmate, to help with the band on their path to the national band competition. He is an alumnus of Kitauji High School and a former student of Tohru Taki. He is fun-loving, athletic, and humorous, and is consequently highly popular with his percussion students.

This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work. 

Please add other narrator characters, which were given a visual representation of themselves, separately from this narrator page.

name.native: トーチャー・トルチュール

node.description:
__Position:__ Grand Inquisitor (Supreme Torturer)
__Favorite Food:__ Sake, Wine, Squid Shiokara, Anchovies, and Chocolate.
__Special Skills:__ "Torture" with good, sewing.

She was scouted to join Hellhorde after they witnessed her reaction to delicious food at a restaurant. She always visits her parents during every holiday. Her younger sister and her sister's husband live at her parents' house, so Torture has been telling them to just clear out and repurpose her old room. But if they actually went through with it, she'd secretly miss it.

__Position:__ Princess, Commander of The Third Legion of The Imperial Army

Eldest daughter of the king, and commander of The Third Legion of The Imperial Army. While The Third Legion is only considered average, Princess herself would outskill even the top ranks of The First Legion in one-on-one combat, or so they say. Has a younger sister. 

Her special skills are sword techniques and swordsmanship in general as well as FPS games.

**Favorite Food:** Beer, plum wine, mayonnaise, and curry.

He is the most powerful and invincible three-eyed monster, standing at the pinnacle of all demons. He has a terrifying, charismatic presence and a dignified appearance, but his true face is that of a doting father who dotes on his only daughter, [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/151038/Maomao). He also has an otaku side, such as following voice actors and watching Sunday morning TV shows.

__Position:__ Harm-Marshal (Senior Tourturer)
__Favorite Food:__  Roast Beef, Scones.
__Special Skills:__ Daughter of the illustrious Peschutz line. Excels at everything (self-proclaimed.) Good at needle felting to make small mascots (according to her parents.)

The Vampire Clan has been around for a long time. Nowadays they don't suck blood directly but instead eat foods rich in iron for nourishment. Their clan is sensitive to the sun. If they spend a long time in sunshine, their skin will get red and irritated the next day.

__Position:__ Hyper Senior Apprentice Torturer
__Favorite Food:__ French Fries, Chocolate Ice Cream, and Apple Juice.
__Special Skills:__ Kendama.

Hell-Lord's only daughter. She works as an apprentice torturer to gain experience, but since her rank is Hyper Senior Apprentice, she outranks even The Grand Inquisitor. Her salary is getting a piece of candy when going shopping with her mom.

__Position:__ Lieutorment (Intermediate Torturer)
__Favorite Food:__ Fugashi, okaki, and lobster.
__Special Skills:__ Strategy games, claw machines.

She joined The Basketball Club at Youki's invitation, but ended up quitting on the first day. Good at housework since both her parents have careers. She has two younger brothers.

__Position:__ Legendary Holy Sword
__Special Skills:__ Resonates with the wielder's magical power to increase sharpness. Can cut through any kind of magic.

A holy sword that can only be used by the chosen one. Best in close combat out of The Three Great Holy Swords. The day before Princess was captured, the blade portion was detached and sent for repairs. The current blade is merely a temporary replacement.

__Position:__ Top-Class Warrior and Harm-Marshall (Senior Torturer)
__Favorite Food:__  Trendy foods, Cute foods, Yakiniku.
__Special Skills:__ Controlling fierce beasts at will. Learned to swim after taking lessons and now excels at long-distance swimming.

Besides combat, she can use the power of beasts to plow wasteland into fields and demolish abandoned towns to free up the land. Never leaves leftovers if the food is good.

__Position:__ Bookstore Employee
__Favorite Food:__ Chocolate Cake, Anything filled with Whipped Cream, Ramen, Karaage.
__Special Skills:__ Cracking eggs with one hand. Doing the back hip circle. Quick at calculating multiples of seven. Great at playing tag.

She's basically a housewife, but she occasionally helps out at her parents' bookstore. She likes landscape photography books and illustrated encyclopedias.

__Position:__ Lieutorment (Intermediate Torturer)
__Special Skills:__ Reflex based games. Making potato chips from scratch.

During her school years she was active in the Basketball Club. She received even more chocolate than the most popular boys did on Valentine's Day. Interested in silver accessories but can't afford them.

__Position:__ Class 4 Warrior and Junior Torturer
__Favorite Food:__ Manju, Miso Soup, and Chikuzenni.
__Special Skills:__ Coming up with travel plans, sauna.

No one has ever seen Giant fight or perform a torture. She is great at maintaining and cleaning bathrooms. "When in doubt about travel plans, go to Giant" is a saying within the Hellhorde.

**Favorite Food:** Sweets and snacks.

He is an "honorary knight" who has served the kingdom for many years and been awarded medals for his numerous military achievements. After retiring, he serves the kingdom as a butler and is tasked with keeping a strict watch over the princess, but he has a bit of a soft spot for her, secretly buying her sweets on the way home from lessons or making detours to Chinese restaurants.

**Favorite Food:** Caesar salad and prosciutto.

Weaponsmith and Junior Torturer. Obtained her Torturer license specifically to “torture” the Holy Sword [Ex](https://anilist.co/character/151040/Ex). She wields her weapons with undeniable skill, relentlessly tormenting Ex. She's on friendly terms with [Torture](https://anilist.co/character/151039/Tortura-Torture) in private, addressing her with the informal “-chan” suffix.
[Tortura's](https://anilist.co/character/151039/) assistant.

name.native: サクラ・ハートロック

node.description:
Raised to be an assassin from birth. Her superiors assigned [Hime](https://anilist.co/character/151042/Hime) as a target, but she failed after getting too close. As a result, she was told to assassinate [Maou](https://anilist.co/character/151044/Maou) but was caught and offered to join the Hellhorde.

~!She later got her torturer license and met with Hime, who forgave her.!~

**Favorite Food:** Steak and sushi.

An excellent aide to the Demon King. Rumor has it that he is the second most powerful in the Demon King's army in terms of combat. He originally joined the Demon King's army as a part-time cleaner, but due to a manpower shortage he began helping out in various ways, eventually becoming a close aide to the Demon King.
[Inki's](https://anilist.co/character/151043/Inki) little brother.

sampleCharacters.name: Tortura Torture
sampleCharacters.description: __Position:__ Grand Inquisitor (Supreme Torturer) __Favorite Food:__ Sake, Wine, Squid Shiokara, Anchovies, and Chocolate. __Special Skills:__ "Torture" with good, sewing. She was scouted to join Hellhorde after they witnessed her reaction to delicious food at a restaurant. She always visits her parents during every holiday. Her younger sister and her sister's husband live at her parents' house, so Torture has been telling them to just clear out and repurpose her old room. But if they actually went through with it, she'd secretly miss it.

sampleCharacters.name: Hime
sampleCharacters.description: __Position:__ Princess, Commander of The Third Legion of The Imperial Army Eldest daughter of the king, and commander of The Third Legion of The Imperial Army. While The Third Legion is only considered average, Princess herself would outskill even the top ranks of The First Legion in one-on-one combat, or so they say. Has a younger sister. Her special skills are sword techniques and swordsmanship in general as well as FPS games.

sampleCharacters.name: Maou
sampleCharacters.description: **Favorite Food:** Beer, plum wine, mayonnaise, and curry. He is the most powerful and invincible three-eyed monster, standing at the pinnacle of all demons. He has a terrifying, charismatic presence and a dignified appearance, but his true face is that of a doting father who dotes on his only daughter, [Maomao](https://anilist.co/character/151038/Maomao). He also has an otaku side, such as following voice actors and watching Sunday morning TV shows.

sampleCharacters.name: Vanilla Peschutz
sampleCharacters.description: __Position:__ Harm-Marshal (Senior Tourturer) __Favorite Food:__ Roast Beef, Scones. __Special Skills:__ Daughter of the illustrious Peschutz line. Excels at everything (self-proclaimed.) Good at needle felting to make small mascots (according to her parents.) The Vampire Clan has been around for a long time. Nowadays they don't suck blood directly but instead eat foods rich in iron for nourishment. Their clan is sensitive to the sun. If they spend a long time in sunshine, their skin will get red and irritated the next day.

sampleCharacters.name: Maomao
sampleCharacters.description: __Position:__ Hyper Senior Apprentice Torturer __Favorite Food:__ French Fries, Chocolate Ice Cream, and Apple Juice. __Special Skills:__ Kendama. Hell-Lord's only daughter. She works as an apprentice torturer to gain experience, but since her rank is Hyper Senior Apprentice, she outranks even The Grand Inquisitor. Her salary is getting a piece of candy when going shopping with her mom.

sampleCharacters.name: Inki
sampleCharacters.description: __Position:__ Lieutorment (Intermediate Torturer) __Favorite Food:__ Fugashi, okaki, and lobster. __Special Skills:__ Strategy games, claw machines. She joined The Basketball Club at Youki's invitation, but ended up quitting on the first day. Good at housework since both her parents have careers. She has two younger brothers.

sampleCharacters.name: Ex
sampleCharacters.description: __Position:__ Legendary Holy Sword __Special Skills:__ Resonates with the wielder's magical power to increase sharpness. Can cut through any kind of magic. A holy sword that can only be used by the chosen one. Best in close combat out of The Three Great Holy Swords. The day before Princess was captured, the blade portion was detached and sent for repairs. The current blade is merely a temporary replacement.

sampleCharacters.name: Krall
sampleCharacters.description: __Position:__ Top-Class Warrior and Harm-Marshall (Senior Torturer) __Favorite Food:__ Trendy foods, Cute foods, Yakiniku. __Special Skills:__ Controlling fierce beasts at will. Learned to swim after taking lessons and now excels at long-distance swimming. Besides combat, she can use the power of beasts to plow wasteland into fields and demolish abandoned towns to free up the land. Never leaves leftovers if the food is good.

sampleCharacters.name: Lulune
sampleCharacters.description: __Position:__ Bookstore Employee __Favorite Food:__ Chocolate Cake, Anything filled with Whipped Cream, Ramen, Karaage. __Special Skills:__ Cracking eggs with one hand. Doing the back hip circle. Quick at calculating multiples of seven. Great at playing tag. She's basically a housewife, but she occasionally helps out at her parents' bookstore. She likes landscape photography books and illustrated encyclopedias.

sampleCharacters.name: Youki
sampleCharacters.description: __Position:__ Lieutorment (Intermediate Torturer) __Special Skills:__ Reflex based games. Making potato chips from scratch. During her school years she was active in the Basketball Club. She received even more chocolate than the most popular boys did on Valentine's Day. Interested in silver accessories but can't afford them.

sampleCharacters.name: Giant
sampleCharacters.description: __Position:__ Class 4 Warrior and Junior Torturer __Favorite Food:__ Manju, Miso Soup, and Chikuzenni. __Special Skills:__ Coming up with travel plans, sauna. No one has ever seen Giant fight or perform a torture. She is great at maintaining and cleaning bathrooms. "When in doubt about travel plans, go to Giant" is a saying within the Hellhorde.

sampleCharacters.name: Jimochi
sampleCharacters.description: **Favorite Food:** Sweets and snacks. He is an "honorary knight" who has served the kingdom for many years and been awarded medals for his numerous military achievements. After retiring, he serves the kingdom as a butler and is tasked with keeping a strict watch over the princess, but he has a bit of a soft spot for her, secretly buying her sweets on the way home from lessons or making detours to Chinese restaurants.

sampleCharacters.name: Gilga
sampleCharacters.description: **Favorite Food:** Caesar salad and prosciutto. Weaponsmith and Junior Torturer. Obtained her Torturer license specifically to “torture” the Holy Sword [Ex](https://anilist.co/character/151040/Ex). She wields her weapons with undeniable skill, relentlessly tormenting Ex. She's on friendly terms with [Torture](https://anilist.co/character/151039/Tortura-Torture) in private, addressing her with the informal “-chan” suffix.

sampleCharacters.name: Kanadge
sampleCharacters.description: **Favorite Food:** Steak and sushi. An excellent aide to the Demon King. Rumor has it that he is the second most powerful in the Demon King's army in terms of combat. He originally joined the Demon King's army as a part-time cleaner, but due to a manpower shortage he began helping out in various ways, eventually becoming a close aide to the Demon King.

sampleCharacters.name: Insuke
sampleCharacters.description: [Inki's](https://anilist.co/character/151043/Inki) little brother.

Hikayat Kekaisaran Tearmoon ~Cerita Putri yang Reinkarnasi ke Masa Lalu Dimulai dari Hukuman Penggal~
